precepts.label: Romans 8:36
precepts.why:
Paul writes: “As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.” That is prophecy right there. And where is it written? In this psalm: “Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen”, and “Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.”

So when Paul was writing Romans 8:36, where do you think he got it? From Psalms. That is why he always said, bring the books and the parchments: the letters he was going to write would reference things already written in the Old Testament.

The sheep appointed for meat, scattered among the heathen, is Deuteronomy 28:64 fulfilled. God sold us for nought; he was not looking for financial gain when he allowed us to be sold. And Paul carried the same understanding into the New Testament: the people of God would be killed all the day long and counted as sheep for the slaughter. It did not stop with the apostles; it is still happening to our people today.

precepts.label: Matthew 24:9
precepts.why:
The psalm says, “Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us. Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.” Everybody hates us. They have nicknames for us. When we come around, they shake their heads: look at this, you want to move into the neighborhood here?

Christ said it first: “Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.”

In a clip shown in class, an Arab man said plainly that everybody is anti-black, not just the Arabs. Reflect back on this verse: he didn't lie. Christ said everybody is against us. Everybody.

That is the confusion the psalm speaks of. Our people go to school, get the education, talk like them, walk like them, wear the fake hair, and still get cast off, like the hundreds of thousands of black women with stable federal jobs dismissed in Trump's purge. We were not brought to this country to prosper and stay here. We were brought here to serve out our punishment, learn to repent of our sins, and then go back to greatness. Christians don't understand that.

precepts.label: Malachi 1:4
precepts.why:
“But unto the wicked God saith”. Who is the wicked? Malachi gives the name: “Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places”. Edom is Esau, Mount Seir; it is the same subject.

But “thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” They shall call Edom the border of wickedness. And note it says the people, not the person. The apologists like to play word games and say it is talking about the person Esau. No: people is plural, meaning all of them. And how long is the Lord's indignation against them? For ever.

So the psalm is speaking to Edom: “What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?” Esau said in Ezekiel 35:10, “These two nations and these two countries shall be mine”: the kingdoms of Judah and Israel, and the two countries America and Israel. They took America as Christians and the land of Israel as Jewish people.

One group of Esau took the new covenant as Christians and took the land. The other group, in 1948, took the old covenant and said, we are the Jews. Whether they call themselves Jewish or Christian, they hate instruction and cast God's words behind them. They are the wicked, the border of wickedness.

thread.label: Psalms 55:12
thread.text: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

precepts.label: Psalms 55:21
precepts.why:
“For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it.” It was not the enemy that set David up, or he would have been ready, because he knows who the enemy is. “But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance. We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.” It was the man he trusted, the man he went fishing with, and that took him by surprise. Later in the same psalm David describes that man: “The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.”

A man mine equal: an officer of ten, of twenty, of fifty, just like me. We took sweet counsel together: Deacon, I need counsel; Captain, what do you think about this? But while he was taking counsel, he was plotting. Some are plotting to take your wife: she is too beautiful for him. Some are plotting to take your position at the job you brought them into, telling the white man, give me his position. I picked him up every Sabbath and every Wednesday, and when he came to betray me he had no problem doing it.

“Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.” Christ was betrayed that way: “Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?” Today we do not kiss, but we dap: Shalom, Captain, Most High bless. That smooth greeting can be the betrayal. In 2018 a man who sat in another man's house, barbecued and travelled with him, came and took all his furniture and put his children to sleep on the cold floor.

Jeremiah warns: “Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.” Supplant means betray, plot. Other camps slander our members and leadership, because they know our people believe anything without proof; they are Esau in black skin, who “have taught their tongue to speak lies.” They come asking to fellowship, but we are not stupid.

It was not the enemy that killed Thomas Sankara; it was his best friend, who grew up with him. It was Maduro's own handpicked bodyguards who stood down and handed him over, taking American money instead of a bullet for him. That is war in the heart behind smooth words. David is telling you: do not fall asleep.

thread.label: Psalms 55:20
thread.text: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

precepts.label: Psalms 58:3
precepts.why:
“He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.” Venezuela is a peaceful country. America put an embargo and sanctions on Venezuela for twenty years to destroy its economy; the money goes down, everything goes down. Then twenty years later: he is a drug dealer, he is this, he is that; people of Venezuela, we can change your lives. America did that. “The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart.”

Only the simple will believe it was about drug trafficking. Trump pardoned one of the biggest drug dealers a couple of months before, and Mexico, on America's border, has more drug cartels than any place in the world. Then the story shifted to oil. They use the same stupidity because they know some black people will believe that garbage. Ninety-nine point nine percent of the words that come out of the Trump mouth are a lie. He lies even when he is not talking; he is blinking and lying, and every person who works for him too.

David shows why: “The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.” The little baby is born, he does not even talk yet, and he is looking at you lying. That is Trump: before he can say a word he already starts lying. All of them. God said it, not me: it is in them to be liars. And our people believe them, because they are white. Who told you the white man cannot lie?

Habakkuk describes the same man, whose “soul which is lifted up is not upright in him.” Esau is not right: “he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home”: he is in everybody's business, with bases around the world used to overthrow any government that does not do what he says. He destroys the economy with sanctions, sends in CIA agitators and propaganda to raise the people up, and then comes back as the good guy offering to help. Like a man who rapes a woman and then offers to take her to therapy.

That is putting forth his hands against such as be at peace with him. The wicked go astray from the womb speaking lies, and his smooth words always have war in his heart.

precepts.label: Revelation 17:16
precepts.why:
The psalm says the wicked “shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves”. Their tongue is their media, how they speak through social media, and John shows how that tongue turns on them: “And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.”

The ten horns is Europe. They are going to hate America. To make her “desolate” is to destroy this place. To make her “naked” is to expose her: your sins showing, your shame showing. A lot of the evil America and Europe did together is going to be exposed.

You see it happening today. Europe is saying you are wrong for what Israel did in Palestine, killing all these kids, and they brought charges against Netanyahu and put a warrant out for his arrest for war crimes. Whistleblowers are telling on each other. That is their own tongue falling upon themselves. That is why they want to take TikTok and X and control the warfare, but they are not going to be able to change nothing.

Job shows the same end for the wicked man: “The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.” The heaven revealing his iniquity starts with us: as we teach the word of God, the angels make things happen, Europe starts showing America's shame, and everybody sees the oppressor for what she is, and not just America but Israel too. Then “a fire not blown shall consume him”: a fire you do not have to fan, the nuclear bomb, and “it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle”, left here in America.

The earth that rises up against him is the nations. Isaiah shows it: “Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming”, hell being that low condition everybody on the earth is in, and “it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.” “How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning!” How are you fallen from ruling, O America. All nations rise up to fight against America and destroy her.

So leave social media alone. It was created to monitor you, brainwash you and control you. God is going to save the poor from their mouth, and their own tongue will bring them down.

But the psalm says the Lord looked down from heaven “To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death.” We are the prisoner. thread.text: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say;

classes.title: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

precepts.label: Lamentations 3:22
precepts.why:
King David says, “If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say”: the Lord was on Israel’s side, “when men rose up against us”, when the nations rose up against us. Think about that. The only reason we are still breathing is the mercy of the Lord.

Lamentations says it plainly: “It is of the Lord’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.” That we, brothers and sisters, are still here is only because of the Lord. With the weapons Esau has and the weapons the nations have, if the Lord put the spirit on them to do what they do and gave them free reign with us, we would all have been wiped out.

Read on: “They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.” “The Lord is my portion, saith my soul”. His compassion does not fail, and that is why Psalms 124 can say the nations did not swallow us up.

precepts.label: Numbers 14:18
precepts.why:
“The Lord is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression”. Being longsuffering is one of the characteristics we must take on with our brothers and our sisters. A lot of times we are carnal and have no patience with each other. A brother offends you, or does what you think is an offence that he may not even see as one, and you get all in your feelings; sisters get in their feelings about something somebody said or the way somebody moves toward them. We are all different spirits joining together for one common goal. We are not all going to get along, but we all have to be longsuffering with each other and endure it.

Then: “and by no means clearing the guilty”. Why is he of great mercy but will by no means clear the guilty? Just because you sin and are not judged immediately does not mean you will not be judged; you are still guilty of that sin. And to get that great mercy, you have to repent and forsake your sins. The ones he will not clear are those that do not repent, and he visits “the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.”

So back to Psalms 124: it is of the Lord’s mercy, longsuffering with Israel, that the men who rose up against us did not swallow us up.

precepts.label: Isaiah 17:12
precepts.why:
Psalms 124 goes on: “Then they had swallowed us up quick”, the nations would have swallowed us up, “Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:” “Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.” The waters are not the water of affliction. Write it down, brothers: the waters in Psalms 124 are the nations.

Isaiah proves it: “Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!” Keep reading: “The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters”. He is comparing the nations to waters.

“but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.” That is the Lord being on our side: the proud waters, the nations, rush against Israel, and God rebukes them.

precepts.label: Revelation 17:15
precepts.why:
One more precept on the waters: “The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.” The waters are peoples and nations again, and the one sitting on them is America. Look at where America sits: bases and fleets all over the earth.

So what could Russia do with this? America does not have to send its entire fleet to Russia or to China; it is already there, it does not have to go anywhere. If I was Trump, I might boast too. Look at the weaponry he has.

That is the power of the nations the Psalm is talking about. “Then the proud waters had gone over our soul”, but “Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.” Because of the Lord’s mercies, “Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.” And “Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth”: that name is God’s commandments with faith in his Son.

thread.label: Proverbs 14:25-26
thread.text: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.

precepts.label: Titus 1:13
precepts.why:
“A true witness delivereth souls”: a true prophet, a true servant, delivers souls. Paul shows how a true witness does it: “This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith.”

It is our job, brothers, to rebuke our people sharply. Why? That they may be sound in the faith; that they may repent. That is how souls are delivered.

So whose soul have you been delivering? You have been sitting here five years, seven years, ten years; some of you cannot even deliver your own soul, because you forgot the mission. Who are you working for, spiritually: Messiah or Satan? Some of you are agents working for Esau.

“but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.” Our people love lies, and the deceitful witness feeds them lies. That is why you see ten thousand, twenty thousand in the Christian churches: they do not want the truth. They say Christ cannot be black, Christ cannot come only for the Israelite. The truth to us is a foreign language. That is why the true witness has to rebuke sharply: sharp rebuke is what brings a people who love lies to repentance.

precepts.label: Romans 8:29
precepts.why:
“In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence.” Some of you have no confidence and low self-esteem because you have no fear of God, sitting in the same seat for seven years. Romans shows what God called you for: “For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.”

What does it mean to be conformed? To change. We must change to the image of Jesus Christ. Some of you have not changed yet, and we can see it.

We can see the potential on you: this brother has the spirit to do great things in Israel. But you have to see it. My job as a deacon is to push your spirit and to build you up, but no matter how much I build you up, if you cannot see it, I cannot make you see it. You have to get up and see it yourself.

There is a lot of work to do while you are waiting for the kingdom, and the kingdom does not come by observation. When temptation and tribulation come, the one who has not been conformed will run, because mentally and spiritually he is not strong enough to endure it. Being predestinated to be conformed means you have to do the changing.

precepts.label: Ephesians 1:5
precepts.why:
“Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will.” The same God who foreknew us and predestinated us to be conformed to the image of his Son predestinated us unto the adoption of children, by Jesus Christ, to himself.

That calling is what the class carried straight into Paul: “For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!” Paul understood he was a servant, sent to serve the people and deliver souls. Destruction unto me if I do not do what I was sent to do.

“For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward.” You have to do it willingly, not because somebody forced you; a brother forced to do something has no spirit in it. Yet some of you get up at four in the morning and willingly give the white man eight or twelve hours without complaining, while coming here on the Sabbath is a burden.

So being predestinated as children by Jesus Christ is not a reason to sit and wait. God did not call you here just to sit and listen. It is a call to be the true witness that delivers souls, and in the fear of the Lord is the strong confidence to do it.

“The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.” The king in this nation right now, in 2026, is Donald Trump. His heart is in the hand of the Lord, and whatever way the Lord wants him to go, he is going to go, and he is going to fulfill what the Lord has in store.

Daniel shows why: “This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men.” God rules in the kingdoms of men. God is the ultimate ruler.

And what does he do? He “giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.” He gives the kingdom over to whomever he chooses, and he sets over it the basest of men: the least of men, the bottom feeders. The bottom feeders are ruling us right now. Biden, Trump, Putin, all of them: they are the bottom.

So the king’s heart turning like rivers of water and the Most High setting up the basest of men are the same truth. Trump is not ruling by his own power. He is set up by the Most High and turned whithersoever he will, a sword in the hand of God to bring judgment on the nations.

“Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.” The last part is the point: the kisses of an enemy are deceitful. And Luke shows the kiss: “Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?” Judas betrayed Christ with a kiss. The man betrayed him with the very sign of love.

Today we do not greet each other with a kiss like that, but we have our own greeting: Shalom, Captain, Most High bless. That is the betrayal. The embrace, the salute, the Shalom, and then the knife. That is the kiss of an enemy.

We saw it in 2018. A man who had been in another man’s house, greeting him with Shalom, barbecuing together, traveling together, came to that same man’s house, took all his furniture and put his children on the cold floor to sleep. He did not care. Not only did he betray the man, he betrayed all his children.

There is nothing worse than a traitor. And some of you think once you betray your brother or your sister, that is the end of it. It is not. The one who betrays with a kiss will be dealt with too. That is why the kisses of an enemy are called deceitful: Judas is the pattern of the familiar hand that destroys.

thread.label: Ecclesiastes 1:9
thread.text: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.

precepts.label: Ecclesiastes 6:10
precepts.why:
“The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be”. What is the thing that hath been? Solomon says: “That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man”. So the thing is man.

Read Ecclesiastes 1:9 again with that: “and that which is done is that which shall be done”. The same thing man did in the past, he is going to come back and do again. “there is no new thing under the sun.” If you were wicked in the past, you are going to be wicked again when you come back on the earth. That is why the scripture says he that is righteous, let him be righteous still, and he that is evil, let him be evil still. If you are righteous, you will gravitate to righteous brothers and sisters; if you are wicked, to wicked people.

Why is this important? Because what was done to us in slavery is a circle coming back around. God's judgment is as a ring. Slavery isn't over; the white man put a fake smile on his face, and now he is showing his real face. It is the same people coming back to do the same thing. Antiochus died long ago under the Greeks, yet the scripture says he shall stand up against the Prince of princes, because the same spirit that came against the holy people is going to do it again.

So just as Egypt said, the children of Israel “are more and mightier than we”, and “let us deal wisely with them”, America, spiritual Egypt, does the same today: the census, abortions and Planned Parenthood, changing laws as we become the majority. The thing that repeats is man himself.

precepts.label: Romans 15:4
precepts.why:
“behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power”. That's us. Our oppressors have power: they organize themselves, pass laws and policies, colonize, oppress and exploit. And the Israelites had no comforter.

So what is supposed to comfort us? Paul says: “For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” Whatsoever was written aforetime means this Bible, and it was written for our learning. We ought to learn from what happened to the Israelites, to the apostles, and to Christ.

“comfort of the scriptures”: this is our comforter. The scriptures of this Bible are where the oppressed find comfort, and that is what we need to hope in.

The oppressors hold all the cards right now, and the one who has no comforter in the world has one in the word. If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, the nations would have swallowed us up; it is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed.

precepts.label: Job 3:11
precepts.why:
Because of verse 1, with no comforter and all the power on the side of our oppressors, Solomon says: “Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.” Better than both is he “which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.” He would rather praise the dead, who are not going through the oppression, than the living, who are depressed, oppressed, suppressed, pressed all kinds of ways.

Job said the same: “Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?” Job was going through tribulation hell: his wife on him, his kids dying, the skin disease, his lands, everything lost. Why didn't I just die already? Why am I still here?

“For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest”. If he had slept, meaning been dead, he would have been at rest, not going through the hell he was going through; or as “infants which never saw light”, meaning stillborn. “There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest. There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.” We are the prisoners. In death they don't have to deal with oppressors no more.

That is how heavy the oppression of Ecclesiastes 4:1 is. And the only reason we are still breathing is the mercy of the Lord, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

precepts.label: Zechariah 1:15
precepts.why:
“there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.” That is Esau. The way Esau treated us is going to be to his own detriment.

The Lord says it in Zechariah: “And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.” Yes, we sinned against our God. Yes, the Lord allowed us to go into the hands of our enemies. But they took it too far.

God was but a little displeased with Israel, and the heathen helped forward the affliction. You think Christ ain't see that? That is why Esau's rule over Jacob is to his own hurt: he went past what God allowed, and the Lord is sore displeased with him for it.

precepts.label: Isaiah 63:9
precepts.why:
“In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them”. In all of our affliction, through all of our slavery, the Lord saw all of it.

In all our affliction he was afflicted. So when he comes back, he is going to feel all of that pain and all of that suffering they did to the children of Israel, and he is going to wreak havoc on these nations.

“the angel of his presence saved them”. Salvation is not for the oppressors. Salvation is for those who have been afflicted. The man that ruled over another did it to his own hurt, because the one he afflicted is the one the Lord saves.

precepts.label: Psalms 119:85
precepts.why:
“The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.” The proud have digged pits for God's people.

They are not after God's laws. Look at it: how come you can abort in America? How come gay marriage is legalized? They don't keep God's laws and they don't uphold God's laws, but a lot of you coons out there follow behind this white man. They are not after God's commandments.

And who are the proud? Obadiah answers: it is Edom. The man that rules over another in Ecclesiastes 8 is the same proud one digging pits for Jacob, and his own pit is where he is headed.

precepts.label: Obadiah 1:1-3
precepts.why:
Who are the proud that digged the pits? “The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?”

And who is he speaking to? Verse 1: “The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom”. Concerning Edom: Esau, your friendly neighborhood white man, your Europeans, and the Americans.

Edom's pride has deceived him into thinking none shall bring him down. That is the one man who rules over another, and Solomon says he does it “to his own hurt.”

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 27:26-29
precepts.why:
“Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that setteth a trap shall be taken therein.” The proud digged pits for us, and they will fall in them. They thought evil against us, but the Lord saw it for good. Jacob is going to win in the end.

“He that worketh mischief, it shall fall upon him, and he shall not know whence it cometh.” That is what they do: they work mischief and call it law. And he is not going to know where it came from, because his pride has deceived him.

“Mockery and reproach are from the proud”. That is all they do: they accuse us, falsely accuse us, and mock us. “but vengeance, as a lion, shall lie in wait for them.” That lion is the one in Jeremiah 4:7.

“They that rejoice at the fall of the righteous shall be taken in the snare; and anguish shall consume them before they die.” Remember when they said raze it, raze it to the ground? The Lord has not forgotten. They will be taken in the snare. It does not pay to be wicked, and it does not pay to follow after your oppressor, because in the end they are going to be destroyed.

precepts.label: Psalms 94:20
precepts.why:
He that worketh mischief: that is what they do. “Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?” They work mischief and then call it law.

Two men getting married, two women getting married: all of these laws. Think about what Trump has done since he came into office: all of the firing and all the DEI hires, all of this is against us. They frame mischief and call it law.

A throne of iniquity cannot have fellowship with God. The ruler that frames mischief by a law over another man is ruling to his own hurt, and the mischief he works shall fall upon him.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 4:7
precepts.why:
Sirach said vengeance, as a lion, shall lie in wait for the proud. Jeremiah shows the lion: “The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate; and thy cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.”

The destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way, to make the land desolate, without an inhabitant.

And that is twofold. It is talking about Nebuchadnezzar, and it is talking about Christ. The lion that came up against the land in the days of Jeremiah is a picture of the Lion that is coming for the nations that ruled over Israel to their own hurt.

precepts.label: Isaiah 26:10-14
precepts.why:
“Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness”. If favour was shown to Esau, he still wouldn't change his wicked ways. It does not pay to be wicked.

“in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the Lord.” Where is the land of uprightness? The land of Israel. And what did he do there? He stole it. He will not behold the majesty of the Lord: he changes his image to a white man with stringy blonde hair and blue eyes.

“Lord, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people”. The people are God's chosen people, the ones the heathen envy in 2 Esdras 2:28. “yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them. Lord, thou wilt ordain peace for us”, like we read earlier in Ephesians 2: he is going to ordain peace for us and destruction for our enemies.

“O Lord our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us”: like the so-called white man, like the Babylonians, like the Assyrians. “but by thee only will we make mention of thy name. They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.” All of our enemies, all of these other lords that had rule over us, are dead. That is the hurt of the man that ruled over another.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 2:28
precepts.why:
Isaiah said the wicked shall see and be ashamed for their envy at the people. Who are those people? God's chosen people. Ezra says it: “The heathen shall envy thee, but they shall be able to do nothing against thee, saith the Lord.”

The heathen shall envy the Israelites. But they shall be able to do nothing. They can't stop it, because they ain't going to be in rulership any more. They are not going to have ownership any more.

That is the end of the man who ruleth over another to his own hurt: the time of his rule runs out, and all his envy cannot stop what the Lord has spoken for Israel.

precepts.label: Mark 7:21-23
precepts.why:
“And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin.” Dross is waste, refuse, any worthless matter, and the tin goes with the dross. God will turn his hand upon us, the Israelites, and purge away everything within us that is wasteful and useless. What is that? Christ lists it.

“For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts”: from within, out of the mind of men. Evil thoughts: that is dross and tin. “adulteries, fornications, murders, Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness”: every one of them is dross and tin. Add the rest we carry: lying, stealing, child molestation, masturbation, pornography, bestiality, anger, malice. All of it.

“All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.” The dross is not outside of us; it is in us, and that is what God is purging.

So that one verse speaks volumes. The “thee” God turns his hand upon is you and me, and what he purges away is everything that proceeds out of our own hearts and defiles us, so that afterward Israel can be called “The city of righteousness, the faithful city.”

precepts.label: Romans 5:3-5
precepts.why:
For the dross to be purged away, we have to go through some things. Paul shows it: “And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also.” When you read Paul in Hebrews 12 he tells you nobody rejoices in tribulation, but here he gives you the after effect. Why glory in tribulation? “knowing that tribulation worketh patience.” That tribulation goes back to Ecclesiasticus 2: when you come to serve the Lord, prepare your soul for temptation, the hard times. When you go through hell, you learn patience.

“And patience, experience.” Patience gives you experience. A lot of us come into this truth at 30, 40, 50 with experience in the world, but in the truth of God we have no experience. That is the experience we need.

“and experience, hope: And hope maketh not ashamed.” Experience teaches us hope, and hope makes us not ashamed, because we endure to the end, “because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.”

So the purging of Isaiah 1:25 is done through tribulation. God turns his hand upon us, and what we go through works patience, experience and hope in us, until the dross and the tin are gone.

precepts.label: 2 Timothy 2:20-21
precepts.why:
God will “purely purge away thy dross.” Paul uses that same word, purge. “But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver.” The great house is the nation of Israel, the twelve tribes. We are not speaking for the other camps, with their cookouts on the Sabbath, their raping of girls, their stealing money for Maseratis and beating the baby mothers; we speak for Israel United in Christ. In every IUIC school, Philly, DC, Virginia, New York, Atlanta, Connecticut, OKC, there are men and women who are gold and silver, and it is up to you to discern and identify who they are.

“but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.” In every school there are also brothers and sisters of wood and of earth: they are not right. This is not about new brothers and sisters who just walked through the door; we all walk in not right. It is about men and women in this truth for years who have not changed: still murmurers and gossipers, putting forth no work and no effort to study and improve. To them it is a social club, a place to hang out with the homeboys, drink a little wine, then go home and play dominoes. The vessels of dishonor are here to try you, and every bird clings to its like; see who groups together.

“If a man therefore purge himself from these”: you have to know your circle. When the Bishop came into the truth he had a circle of five or six brothers he was always getting in trouble around, down to jumping the turnstile with them and getting a ticket. He had to change his circle and get around leadership and the elders to get his mind right. Don’t worry about hurting feelings; if you know they are not right, separate from them.

“he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.” Then God can use you. Then we can send that brother to a city or a state and he can grow a whole congregation, like Isaiah telling the Lord, send me.

And this is why we cannot join with the other camps: it is based on what we just read. Only a fool would do that. The same purging God does in Isaiah, we must do ourselves.

precepts.label: Isaiah 58:1
precepts.why:
“The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see. Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand.” The high mountain is the government, America. The banner we lift up upon it is the Bible. So in the midst of all this chaos, Isaiah sees the prophets still going out teaching.

“Exalt the voice unto them”: that is what we do, and Isaiah 58 says how. “Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.” We exalt the voice, we spare not, we lift up our voice as a trumpet.

“Shake the hand”: warn our people, “that they may go into the gates of the nobles.” The nations have drunk Babylon's wine, her lies and philosophies, what Daniel calls her policy, and therefore the nations are mad. War is coming, and in the midst of all that war, the prophets are still crying aloud, showing our people their transgression so they can be saved.

precepts.label: 2 Corinthians 5:11
precepts.why:
Isaiah sees the war coming on Babylon and the prophets still lifting up the banner and exalting the voice. Paul says why we do it: “Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men.” In Job he is called the king of terrors. We know what the Lord is going to do. The Lord set us up as watchmen, and since we know the terror of the Lord, we must persuade men.

“But we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.”

Who are we trying to persuade? Our people, in the midst of all kinds of sin. So brothers, we must be studying, so that when we come across our people we are able to help them. The scripture says the whole head is sick: we are sick individuals ourselves. But we must learn to discipline ourselves, and we must learn how to persuade our people to change their lives.

precepts.label: 1 Timothy 1:9-10
precepts.why:
These are the kind of people we are trying to persuade to change: “Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane.” It is for our people who are lawless.

“For murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers.” If you knew a brother murdered his father or his mother, you would not treat him the same; your instant reaction is, bro, you cold, who does that? “For manslayers”: imagine being cool with a brother and not knowing the whole time he had bodies on him. But there is repentance for those spirits. These are the spirits we are trying to win over and get to submit to the Lord.

“For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind”: women with all kinds of men, men with all kinds of women, and homosexuality. There is repentance for all of these sins. Some of us are struggling with one, two, three, four, five of these. God damn. We have demons on us.

The only way to get it out is to have one counsellor of a thousand and open up. That is the problem: some of you don't want to open up, and by the time we find out what you are struggling with, it's too late to help. It doesn't mean you can't repent, but it is a lot harder because you kept it secret so long, and by the time you tell us you are already having sex and we have to throw you out. Repent, submit yourself to the Lord, and stay close with the pack.

“For menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine.” How many of us lie? We all lie. Why didn't you come to the Sabbath? My back, I was tired: a lie. Why didn't you come to the new moon? I got off work late: a lie, because in your mind you already said, I'll go next time.

Can you persuade a murderer, a lesbian, a homosexual to change their life? Can you turn a liar or a thief into a soldier? You can, and the proof is that you are sitting in the building. Don't say only Deacon Eythan or Black Rhino knows how to talk to people.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 16:63-64
precepts.why:
We are to persuade our people, but this is what we have to overcome: “Surely he knoweth your inventions, and what ye think in your hearts, even them that sin, and would hide their sin.” That is what we do. We sin, and we hide our sin.

The Lord says, I know your inventions. I know why you watch HBO at night; I know why you like Spartacus, why you like Power. I know you love to smoke weed and spray yourself with cologne right before you come to the Sabbath, and then security says, that brother smells like weed. Keep smoking weed and you will end up face down in the street like the man in the video, calling the officer papi.

Some brothers are tied to unbelieving wives who cook pork on the same grill next to your lawful food, still go to the club and don't respect you, and you refuse to leave. Sisters are tied to unbelieving men. There is no love among our people, and we are caught up in these sins, lawless, like 1 Timothy 1:9.

You can hide it from the brothers and the sisters, but you cannot hide it from the Lord. He knows your inventions and what you think in your heart. So before we can persuade our people, we have to get ourselves right.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 7:61
precepts.why:
“That there should not be such heaviness in their destruction, as shall be joy over them that are persuaded to salvation.” We must persuade men to salvation. We see the wars going on with Iran; we see the prophecies coming to pass and escalating. But the Lord told us, go persuade my people to salvation, go bring them into the sanctuary.

How do we do it? Proverbs 25:15: “By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.” To forbear is to patiently restrain. A prince is a very high rank, and with long patience you can persuade even princes. And what does Israel mean? Prince of the power. We have to be patient with the Israelites.

As teachers, be patient and strategic. When you are having that conversation, don't think they are just wicked as hell; they might actually repent, but you were not patient enough. Be diplomatic, learn how to reason. When people come up to you in the street, don't hit them with the first death scripture. You were once in that spot, and the only reason we are in this building is that the Lord opened our eyes.

A soft tongue breaks the bone: somebody can be pissed with you, and you respond with peace. You from Brooklyn, from DC, from PG County, want to respond even more aggressive. But the joy over one of our people persuaded to salvation is greater than the heaviness over the destruction of the rest.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 15:28-30
precepts.why:
Isaiah says, “Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.” Before the 70s Iran was always known as Persia; that is the Medes and Persians, the second of Daniel's beasts counting from Babylon. God is going to stir them up against the United States of America, Babylon, and all the bombs, the warfare and the destroying of their economy that America and Israel are doing is what will make them rise up. They will not care about money or gold.

“Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.” They will even kill children. That is the third woe: it starts in the land of Israel and ends with America destroyed. “And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms” … “shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.” That is nuclear destruction.

Ezra shows who sets it off: “Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east: Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.” The dragons of Arabia are the Arabs, the sons of Ishmael. They are the ones who will fully set it off, with the Israelis in the land over there. It will not be Iran first.

“Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood.” The Carmanians are Iran, the Persians. Why are they raging in wrath? Because of all the oppression, the sanctions, the bombing of their cities, the killing of their leaders. In the following years Iran will be under heavy sanctions and bombed a lot by the United States, and America and Israel are trying to back a coup against the Iranian regime. Everything Trump is doing is just fulfilling Bible prophecy: he is making the Persians mad.

We don't give a crap about the Arabs or the Iranians. Those people enslaved us, and God is bringing judgment on them. America is the hammer of God, and God is using America to judge the Arabs and the Persians. Then in the end that same cup America is pouring on them is going to be poured on America.

America is about to turn up affliction on everyone on this earth, including us, and it will get worse and worse, like a woman in travail. So this is not the time to be in la-la land or in the midst of sin. It is the time to prepare ourselves and get our spirit right for what is about to take place.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 11:39-40
precepts.why:
“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!” This is what Lucifer does, what the beast does. Iran has not forgotten what America did, and God has not forgotten what America is doing in the earth right now and all the evil it has done before. The Lord is saying America will have its demise, because of all the evil it is doing on the earth.

“Which didst weaken the nations”: they have Cuba on its knees right now, and those are our brothers and sisters over there. Trump threatened tariffs on any country that sells oil to Cuba, said there will be no more oil or money going to Cuba, zero, and put pressure on Mexico until Mexico pulled away. Then he says Cuba looks ready to fall. Why is it ready to fall? Because you are causing it, Trump. It is the same thing they did to Iran, and to Venezuela. This is what they do everywhere they go.

Ezra names that beast: “Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them?” Esau is the fourth beast, and he is going to bring the end of the times; you can see why.

So the fitches, cummin, principal wheat, appointed barley and rye are the different people we plow for, and the farmer's instruments are the different ways we must deal with them to persuade them to salvation. He was stressed from work, things were going on, his mind just wasn't open, and you didn't discern it. But if you pay attention and watch, the moment comes: Leroy calls and says, I was watching this documentary about the space landing, and I'm starting to think this world isn't what I thought it was. precepts.label: Habakkuk 3:16
precepts.why:
God is “declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done.” Only the God of Israel can do that, and he shows the end to the prophets. Look at the videos of the missiles coming down at night: don't they look like stars falling from heaven? The prophets had never seen a missile, an Iron Dome, a supersonic missile or a nuclear weapon. They described what they saw to the best of their ability, and it is our job to put it together. Put yourself in the prophet's shoes, because you are the prophets; you just don't remember.

Habakkuk describes how it hurts when these missiles hit, because when they hit they bring destruction. You don't want to be around when a missile hits the ground; you don't even want to be ten feet away.

“When I heard, my belly trembled.” That kind of fear is an anxiety sitting inside you, in your chest. He cannot believe what he is watching, but the Lord had to show it to him. “My lips quivered at the voice”: he was shaking, he couldn't even talk straight. “Rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself.” He could not believe the damage this thing was doing, the number of people it killed when it hit.

“That I might rest in the day of trouble.” He is saying, I don't want to be alive to see this. It is so bad I don't want to be around to see it. That is what Psalms 91 means by a thousand falling at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand: he saw the bomb drop and ten thousand people die right there.

That is the end God declared from the beginning, and “My counsel shall stand.” The media say Hamas is finished, Hezbollah has no weapons, Iran is weak; yet Hezbollah fired a hundred missiles into Israel the other day, and Israel cannot destroy Hamas under its nose while Iran is seven times bigger than Israel. We are going with the Bible. If you want the kingdom of heaven, you must accept what comes with it: war, tribulation and death.

thread.label: Isaiah 46:8
thread.text: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.

precepts.label: Amos 3:6
precepts.why:
“Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors. Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else.” Only God is “Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure.” Where do you find God’s counsel? The Bible. Whatever the scripture says, the prophecy is going to happen. Forget the dumb pastors and dumb Christians who do not know anything.

Amos shows who is behind what is happening: “Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it?” The trumpet is the Bible. And yes, there is evil in America, and the Lord has done it.

“Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.” We are the prophets. Our job, brothers, is to prepare our people for what is coming. Our job is not to pick up guns and knives thinking you can do something to the white man; this man will wipe you out just like that. Our job is to bring the people back to Messiah and prepare their minds for the second coming of Jesus Christ, the black Messiah, revealing the Bible plainly so they may repent. Wait on the Lord.

“come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the Lord our God.” We are Zion, and our job is to declare in Zion the work of the Lord: what is coming, and how to fix your spirit and build yourself up. To our brothers and sisters in Venezuela: repent. You cannot stop the white man; let him do what he was supposed to do. The evil in the city is the Lord’s counsel standing, and it is revealed to his prophets.

precepts.label: Revelation 18:10
precepts.why:
“Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon.” Babylon, America, is up on high, a proud nation, and God says he will bring her down. “thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate”, because the prophets will be revealing this devil to his face on the streets, and the world is going to know this is the man of sin, the son of perdition. “uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh”: take off that head covering; you are no righteous woman, you are a hoe. “Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance.”

“But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood.” Death and fire are coming to Babylon, “for the multitude of thy sorceries”: the evil America perpetrates throughout the earth, the LGBT, the murder, the colonization, the imperialism, the genocides.

Is “in one day” read elsewhere? Revelation 18: “Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” That great city Babylon is America, that mighty city no other nation could defeat. In one hour, in one day, her judgment comes.

That one-hour judgment is coming for America. What are you going to do about it? Are you going to survive it? Are you going to put in the work, change your life and repent, or keep playing games because you think you have a little more time?

precepts.label: Isaiah 24:21
precepts.why:
The virgin daughter of Babylon says, “I am, and none else beside me”: I am the one, not the French, not the Arabs; big bad America; my military is in all countries and nobody can do a thing about it. “Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee”: your science, technology and weaponry have perverted you, and now all you do is drop bombs from drones. “Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth”, “and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly.”

Isaiah 24 shows who else is judged with her: “And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.”

The high ones that are on high are Esau in his pride. And with him the kings of the earth, the other nations upon the earth. All nations will be punished, and there is not a thing they can do about it. If the Israelites got punished, why would you not get punished? You have to be punished too.

So Babylon coming down to sit in the dust is part of that day. The Lord brings down the proud one on high first, and the judgment reaches all the kings of the earth.

precepts.label: Psalms 137:7
precepts.why:
Who is the virgin daughter of Babylon? Let's identify her. “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” Destroy it, destroy it. Then, speaking to the same people: “O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed”. Edom is now called the daughter of Babylon, and she is destined to be destroyed.

So Isaiah 47 is the destruction of Babylon, which is Edom, the very thing David said in the psalm. “Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground”: you have been taken down, defeated. Then “there is no throne”: your throne is finished, your throne is over.

Then, “for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.” Babylon calls herself tender and delicate. How? The United States of America says, we are a Christian nation. She has two horns like a lamb, Republicans and Democrats, and says, we are Christian, in God we trust. That is the tender and delicate virgin, and God says she will be called that no more.

The children of Edom who cried to raze Jerusalem to its foundation are the daughter of Babylon today, America, and she is the one who is to be destroyed.

precepts.label: Judges 16:21
precepts.why:
Isaiah tells the daughter of Babylon, “Take the millstones, and grind meal”. What does that mean? When you take millstones and grind meal, you are working. But what kind of work? Look at what happened to Samson.

Samson listened to that woman called Delilah, who got paid to take his strength and destroy this mighty black man. She was a black woman, not an Israelite but a Hamite, a good-looking Hamite, and she gave it to him so good that he told her his secrets and went to sleep on her knees. The Philistines came in, cut his hair, bound him up and took his eyes out: “But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.”

When it says they made him grind, they made him work. That is slavery. Even when you go to prison they make you work, and that is still slavery: look up the 13th Amendment.

So this is what God is saying to America, to these Europeans, these Caucasians: take the millstones and grind meal. Get ready for slavery. Then “uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.” As a tender and delicate virgin her head was covered; God says uncover it, lift the dress to the calf, then to the thigh. The rivers she passes over are the word of God, “the washing of water by the word”. America says, I am a virgin daughter, a Christian nation, and the prophets open the word of God and show she is not, revealing her wickedness.

precepts.label: Revelation 17:16
precepts.why:
“Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.” How is America's nakedness uncovered? Through the prophets: the brothers on the streets, on YouTube, traveling, must uncover America's nakedness and reveal her wickedness. And Christ is not coming back as a man; he is coming back as God, because only a God can take down the United States of America. Russia can't do it, China can't do it. America has bases all over the world, and no other nation has that power.

Revelation 17 shows what happens to America and her allies: “And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” The ten horns on the beast with seven heads are NATO, the EU. They shall hate America, make her desolate and naked, eat her flesh, and burn her with fire. That is the United States of America burnt up and destroyed.

Is America finished then? The party ain't over. 2 Esdras 15 says, “And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of thy land, and consume part of thy glory, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed.” Not all of her is destroyed in that war. The country as we know it is finished, but America is not down yet, with all those bases everywhere.

That is why Isaiah says “I will not meet thee as a man.” The ten horns can make her naked and burn her, but the only one that can finally destroy America is God, Christ when he returns.

precepts.label: Romans 9:17
precepts.why:
The only one that can destroy America is Christ when he returns, and Romans 9 shows why God raised her up at all: “For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.”

Pharaoh was over Egypt, and Egypt has long been destroyed. Pharaoh is a metaphor for Rome, and a metaphor for America today. Revelation calls the great city spiritually Sodom and Egypt, and that is Pharaoh right there.

God raised America up. Why? That he might show his power in her. All the technological advances America has, God allowed her to have. There is no nation, no country, that can match Babylon the Great; that is why they call it the great: it has the greatest technology of all nations. Christ says, I must show my power in you, because I am the only one that can take America out.

Then “and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.” When Christ finally takes them down, his name shall be declared throughout all the earth, because we are going to declare his real name, his true name. That is the vengeance of Isaiah 47: “I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.”

precepts.label: Nahum 3:5
precepts.why:
“Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne.” That is Esau: no more throne, no more power. She calls herself a virgin, and Nahum shows what she really is.

“Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery.” This is the bloody city right here. America is full of lies and robbery: they rob all the nations, and everything that comes out of their mouth is a lie. “Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.” America is that harlot. She destroys families and destroys nations and calls it democracy, bringing freedom, yet does not follow it herself. She sanctions the International Court of Justice when it brings charges against Netanyahu; that court was made to judge the black nations. The white man is above the law.

“Behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face.” God is against this place. He is going to discover America’s skirts and reveal her wickedness: America is not a virgin, she is a hoe who has been sleeping with everybody. “and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.” He is going to show the whole world how evil this place is.

For centuries they murdered, killed and robbed with no cameras, and said, “None seeth me.” Now social media records it and people see the evil in Venezuela, and still they look at the camera and say that is not what happened. The virgin daughter of Babylon who says none seeth me will have her nakedness uncovered before the nations, and through that, our deliverance and our salvation are coming.

thread.label: Isaiah 47:6
thread.text: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:48
precepts.why:
“I was wroth with my people”: wroth means angry. The pictures of our people in slavery, beaten, on the slave ships, lynched, murdered from the time of slavery all the way up to now, are God being wroth with his people. It is like a family album of our family. He allowed the white man to beat the hell out of us, and we were made slaves for the white man.

Deuteronomy 28:48 is what that anger looked like: “he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Think about the mindset of the brother in those conditions, with the big yoke of iron on his neck and in the different positions of slavery. Your mind is going to go crazy, because you know you are not supposed to be in that situation. That is what those torture devices were set to do.

“until he have destroyed thee” means until your mind breaks down, until your manhood is gone and your ability to be free is gone. When you just succumb to being a slave, your mental strength and fortitude to be independent is broken. That is what black people are today.

So Isaiah 47:6 says the same: “thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.” This Christian nation, as they say, showed us no mercy, and laid the yoke heavy even on the oldest among us. And she said “I shall be a lady for ever”, I will be Christian forever, and did not lay these things to heart, “neither didst remember the latter end of it”, though they have the Bible and know what it says will happen at the latter end.

precepts.label: Colossians 2:8
precepts.why:
“I have polluted mine inheritance.” How did God pollute his people? With man-made religions. Paul warns: “Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.” None of these religions are after Christ.

Look at where they came from. Pope Nicholas V, the father of the transatlantic slave trade, and after the popes the Protestants. John Smith created the Baptist religion. Joseph Smith created the Mormon religion in 1830. Ellen G. White created the Seventh-day Adventist religion in 1863. Charles T. Russell created the Jehovah's Witness religion in 1872. Charles Parham created the Pentecostal religion in 1901.

These run from slavery up to 1863, when we so-called got emancipated, and on through Jim Crow and segregation. The same people who held us as slaves handed us these religions. What happened to John 3:16 and Galatians 3:28 while our people were in chains? They took that out of the Bible at that time.

So Isaiah 47:6 shows God allowed us to be polluted: “I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand.” The traditions of men that spoiled our people are part of that pollution, and that is why Christ is the enemy of Christianity.

thread.label: Isaiah 47:8
thread.text: Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:

precepts.label: Nahum 3:4
precepts.why:
“Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly.” Given to pleasures: Lifestyles of the Rich and Famous, champagne wishes and caviar dreams, and it made negroes jealous and envious. “that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.” Only the Most High can say I am; they are setting themselves up as God on earth. “I shall not sit as a widow”: I will always have my allies. “neither shall I know the loss of children”: my citizens will not die. “But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood”: their citizens put to death, and their allies cutting them loose, “for the multitude of thy sorceries.” Their science and technology, like the mystery weapon that left Venezuelan soldiers bleeding through the nose, God calls witchcraft.

Nahum names her: “Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.” The well-favoured harlot is the same whore of Revelation 17, America, the same virgin daughter of Babylon. She is well-favoured because this is Babylon the great: everybody wants to come here; everybody says, I can get rich there.

She is called the mistress of witchcrafts. And in case you did not think it was America: “that selleth nations.” What nations did America sell? The nation of Judah and the nation of Israel, the two kingdoms, sold into slavery. “and families through her witchcrafts”: did they not sell our families? You had better believe they did.

So the one given to pleasures who says I am, and none else beside me, is the harlot of Nahum. Her sorceries, labored in “from thy youth” since July 4th, 1776, are the reason the loss of children and widowhood will come upon her in one day.

thread.label: Isaiah 47:10-15
thread.text: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.

precepts.label: Revelation 18:21-23
precepts.why:
Isaiah tells the virgin daughter of Babylon, “Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth.” God is telling you straight that this Babylon deals in witchcraft. Some might think they are clever and say there are two different Babylons. No: Revelation 18 shows it is the same Babylon the great.

“And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.” That is the same end Isaiah gives: “desolation shall come upon thee suddenly.”

“And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth.” The merchants are their corporations, the same merchants Isaiah names: “even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.”

“for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.” By her sorceries all nations were deceived. That is imagery: what they put out in television and movies to manipulate the people, the way the Huxtables were an example. A film about the young George Washington dropped in theaters just this week, and it is not a coincidence: they want to bring the patriot spirit back for the 250th anniversary. It is witchcraft.

And she has laboured in it from her youth: 1776 is her youth, one of the youngest nations on the planet, with Washington DC laid out by the Freemasons in an upside down pentagram, the White House at the bottom point. That is the star some of our people wear while barbecuing on the Fourth of July, and they should be ashamed. Her astrologers and stargazers “shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them”, and Babylon is thrown down with violence.

thread.label: Isaiah 47:12
thread.text: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.

precepts.label: 2 Peter 3:7
precepts.why:
“Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth.” God is saying, Stand still and use your science, your sorcery, your technology. “Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee”: their generals, admirals and scientists who examine the stars, set up the golden dome and create this missile and that missile. “Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them”: burnt up, destroyed, by nuclear fire, by God’s fire. “there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it”: no comfort for Babylon.

Peter shows that fire: “But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.” This heaven and this earth are reserved unto fire, and the perdition of ungodly men is Christianity and whatever other little religions are here.

The scoffers say, “Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.” They purposely ignore the flood of Genesis 6, when God killed everybody on the planet except eight people: “For this they willingly are ignorant of.” That world perished because of the evils of Cain and his seed.

“But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years.” The beloved is Israel: he “hath given it unto Jacob his servant, and to Israel his beloved.” It has been over three thousand years since the flood, and they say it will never happen again. But “the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night”, “and the elements shall melt with fervent heat.” That is the destiny of America and all nations.

“what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness”: our conversation must change. We see the signs, rivers dried up, presidents being stolen. We look for new heavens and a new earth wherein dwelleth righteousness, the twelve tribes of Israel under Christ, and we must be found of him in peace, without spot and blameless.

precepts.label: Micah 2:11
precepts.why:
“Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine.” We are an afflicted people, and we haven’t realized it yet. We are being put through the wringer because we constantly break his law of commandments, because we departed from God, because we don’t know who we are, and because God has been calling us and we refuse to turn around and come back to him. And we are drunken, but not with wine. Drunken with what? Micah shows it.

“If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.” We are drunk with philosophy and doctrines, the lies we learned here in America. If you follow those doctrines, those laws, those philosophies, those lies, that man is going to be the prophet to you: a prophet to lead you right to hell.

A lot of these wicked and evil pastors are just chasing money, money, money, and don’t give a damn about the people’s souls or their spirits. They don’t care about healing the people, fixing the people and bringing them back to Christ. The people are crying, looking for Christ, and these men mislead them while chasing the dollar bill. Let those men be your prophet if you are going to believe that garbage.

That is why we have gangs in the street, prostitutes in the street, our sons fainted and lying “at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net”: the dead Israelites in the churches are not teaching our people how to keep the Lord’s commandments or how to come back to Christ. But the Lord who “pleadeth the cause of his people” says he has taken the cup of trembling out of our hand, and “I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee.”

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:28
precepts.why:
Isaiah says “Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net”. That is why our young men hang on the corners: uncontrollable, like wild bulls in a net. It's a trap; this system is a trap. “they are full of the fury of the Lord”. What is the fury of the Lord? Deuteronomy 28:15-68, the curses God put upon us, and they are on our young men.

Even this one: “The Lord shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart”. Some of our young men are mentally deranged. The ones doing that new type of singing, drill: they are murderers, they are killers, and they don't care.

It is seen in the neighborhood. A house in Queens, a playground across the street with about twenty adorable little kids running around. Time went by, those little kids grew up, and they were having shootouts, bullets flying through the house, the kids and the wife thrown on the floor. That is what they turned into.

So the sons fainted at the head of all the streets are the sons of Israel under the curse of madness. They are full of the fury of the Lord, the rebuke of thy God, and that is why they cannot be controlled.

thread.label: Isaiah 59:1-21
thread.text: Behold, the Lord’s hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:

precepts.label: Wisdom of Solomon 5:15-23
precepts.why:
Isaiah 59 ends with the Lord seeing “that there was no man”, no intercessor, so his own arm brought salvation: Christ “put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing.” “The Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob”: not all nations. And his covenant is his spirit upon us and his words in our mouth, and in our children's mouths, and our children's children's, for ever. Wisdom of Solomon shows what that Redeemer brings.

“But the righteous live for evermore; their reward also is with the Lord, and the care of them is with the most High.” There is no death to the righteous. If you are in this truth keeping the commandments in the faith of Christ, you live forever; our brothers and sisters whose bodies returned to the dust, those spirits are coming back. We have to believe that.

“Therefore shall they receive a glorious kingdom, and a beautiful crown from the Lord’s hand.” The glorious kingdom shall be on earth: that is New Jerusalem. The crown is the one in 2 Esdras 2:42-45: we are going to get crowned with power. “For with his right hand shall he cover them, and with his arm shall he protect them.”

“He shall take to him his jealousy for complete armour”: Christ is coming back for war. “And make the creature his weapon for the revenge of his enemies”: that leviathan is going to come out and attack those bastards on the navy. “He shall put on righteousness as a breastplate”, the same as we read in Isaiah 59, “and true judgment instead of an helmet. He shall take holiness for an invincible shield. His severe wrath shall he sharpen for a sword, and the world shall fight with him against the unwise.”

“Then shall the right aiming thunderbolts go abroad; and from the clouds, as from a well drawn bow, shall they fly to the mark.” Those weapons won't miss; that lightning won't miss. “And hailstones full of wrath shall be cast as out of a stone bow”, like in the time of Joshua, “and the water of the sea shall rage against them”, tsunamis, “and the floods shall cruelly drown them. Yea, a mighty wind shall stand up against them, and like a storm shall blow them away: thus iniquity shall lay waste the whole earth, and ill dealing shall overthrow the thrones of the mighty.”

That is what we are waiting for: the second coming of Christ. And God would not be just to let the nations off the hook; if he punished his own people, America, England, Japan and Australia will not be unpunished. So while we wait, we must be preparing our hearts, our minds and our souls.

precepts.label: Job 19:19
precepts.why:
“Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.” To supplant is to betray, to plot. Job knew what it is to be betrayed by those closest to him: “All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.”

That is how Maduro was taken in Venezuela. It was betrayal from within. His own elite bodyguards, handpicked for their loyalty and trained to take a bullet for him, took American money instead. The outer guards were told to stand down, the cameras and alarms were disabled, and the last two bodyguards surrendered without firing a single shot. The same thing happened to Jovenel in Haiti. Those were our people, the northern kingdom, and they handed him over. And Esau planned it for more than a year, studying who could be turned: one with a sick daughter, one bitter that others were promoted over him, one disillusioned.

The same spirit is among us. Other Israelite camps want to destroy IUIC by slandering the members and the leadership, because black people will believe anything without proof. They slander the Bishop, the deacons and the captains every chance they get, and then come to the door asking to fellowship. We are good. We don't believe the same thing, and we will never come together with them.

And inside: the brother who says, why is he a captain, I know more scripture than him, why do the young men always travel with the Bishop? Maybe the young men are thirstier for the word than you. They know they don't know everything; you think you know it all. Fix that spirit, or you will be the next traitor, the inward friend turned against those who loved him. God hates a traitor.
