precepts.label: Revelation 18:4-6
precepts.why:
“For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name”. That is what you see now: what is happening with Venezuela, with Cuba, with ICE here in America, and now the US sending troops to Nigeria. The Lord is bringing evil upon his people first. “and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth”. If the Lord is judging us, understand that the judgment of the nations is soon to come.

But if we do not get rid of the idolatry, the same judgment America gets, we would get. So the voice from heaven says, “Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” Come out of the ways of America. Come out of the idolatry.

“For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.” Edom thinks God has forgotten. The Lord remembers every last iniquity, every atrocity, every abomination they have committed. “Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.”

So if we do not repent of the stubbornness, the bullheadedness and the idolatry, we will get the same judgment. That is why we keep hitting these streets, blitzing, travelling and doing the work of the Lord to wake our people up and bring them out of her.

precepts.label: Psalms 17:13-14
precepts.why:
Jeremiah cries, “O thou sword of the Lord, how long will it be ere thou be quiet?” What is the sword of the Lord? David shows it: “Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword: From men which are thy hand, O Lord, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure”.

The wicked are God's sword, men which are his hand. The white man is the sword of the Lord.

So when Jeremiah asks the sword to “put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still”, watch the response: “How can it be quiet, seeing the Lord hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.” The Lord appointed destruction in those lands: Gaza, and Ashkelon just above it where the Israelis are, and the seashore. Baldness is come upon Gaza, and Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley, while the Muslims there cut themselves in prayer to their god, the tatbir.

The day is come “to spoil all the Philistines”, Palestine, and to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon, Lebanon, every helper that remaineth: every group they designate a terror group, like Hezbollah, which was created in 1982 to fight the Israeli invasion of Lebanon. The sword cannot be quiet, because God is causing these wars to repay the nations for what they have done to us, his chosen, Israel.

precepts.label: Isaiah 14:25
precepts.why:
Jeremiah's word came “against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.” The Philistines are the Palestinians. Some scriptures are twofold, threefold, fourfold: Pharaoh smote Gaza then, and today Netanyahu and the Israelis, Amalek, smite Gaza.

Isaiah shows what happens to the one smiting: “That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot”. The Assyrian here is Amalek, and Amalek will be judged. “then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders”: Amalek's yoke departs from off the Palestinians. “This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.” All nations are going to get judgment.

But jump to verse 29: “Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken”. Palestinians, do not rejoice because Amalek is moved out of the way. “for out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent”: a missile. “And the firstborn of the poor shall feed”, and the firstborn of the poor is Christ; “and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.”

“Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke”. Palestine will be dissolved. Not only Amalek, but the Palestinians have to get out of that land too. “the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.”

precepts.label: Zephaniah 2:5
precepts.why:
Remember what Isaiah 14 showed: the Palestinians are going to be destroyed out of that land, and so is Amalek. Zephaniah says it plainly: “Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast”. The sea coast is Gaza. “the nation of the Cherethites” is the Palestinians. “the word of the Lord is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.”

“And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks”, when those missiles hit. Then: “And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the Lord their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.”

The house of Judah will live in Gaza. That is Judah's land, and Benjamin will be there too with the house of Judah. Give the Lord a hand for that.

That is why Jeremiah 47 goes on, “O thou sword of the Lord, how long will it be ere thou be quiet?” The sword cannot be quiet, “seeing the Lord hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.” Gaza is the seashore. The judgment on the Philistines clears the coast for the remnant of Judah.

precepts.label: Psalms 17:13
precepts.why:
“O thou sword of the Lord, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.” A scabbard is the leather sheath you put a sword in. How long will judgment be quiet? “How can it be quiet, seeing the Lord hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.” The seashore is Gaza. The Lord gave the sword a charge, so judgment has to go forth, and missiles are coming there too.

Who is that sword? David tells us: “Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword.” The wicked is the sword of the Lord. That is why this class is called Donald Trump: the Sword of God. The Lord uses the wicked to bring judgment on the nations.

And it is judgment on all the nations, not just Esau. “Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the Lord.” Concerning the Ammonites, Ammon, the Japanese: “Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?” Gad is mixed among them. So “I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap”, and “then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs.”

Then Babylon, which is America, and the land of the Chaldeans, Amalek, the so-called Israel: “Put yourselves in array against Babylon”, “spare no arrows”, “for it is the vengeance of the Lord.” Joel says, “Prepare war, wake up the mighty men”: China, America, Russia, Iran, all must go to war and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat, where the Lord will sit to judge all the heathen round about.

When the sword has done its work, the land comes back to us: “And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah”, and “the Lord their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.” The house of Judah will live in Gaza. And when Babylon falls in one hour, we are told, “Rejoice over her”, “for God hath avenged you on her.”

precepts.label: Luke 5:36-39
precepts.why:
“My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.” The shepherds, the pastors, lead our people from one religion to another, and they have forgotten their restingplace, the word of God. Pastors charged with rape and child abuse, a pastor arrested on counts of rape of girls thirteen and fifteen, two pastors charged in the murder for hire of a blind, mentally disabled man for insurance money: that is how the shepherds have caused them to go astray. Yet Christians do not want to change, just as the Pharisees did not want to change.

Christ told them a parable: “No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.” Christ is the piece of new garment; the new covenant was being ushered in and they were not ready for it. It agreed not with the old covenant: animal sacrifice was replaced by the sacrifice of Christ.

“And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish. But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.” The new wine is the new covenant in Christ. The new bottles are us being born again: new creatures, new men, new women.

“No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.” That is how the Pharisees and scribes felt about Christ's teaching, and so it is today with Christians and the true teaching of Christ and the Israelites. Our people like their old ways and old traditions, and when we bring them the new covenant in Christ by keeping the commandments, they say, I don't want that. So “their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the Lord, the habitation of justice, even the Lord, the hope of their fathers.”

precepts.label: Joel 3:9
precepts.why:
Jeremiah's word is “against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans”. Babylon here is America; the Chaldeans are Amalek, so-called Israel. And it is not just Esau: it is judgment on all the nations. “Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the Lord.” “for it is the vengeance of the Lord: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.”

Joel shows who is called up to do it: “Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up”. The Gentiles are the other nations, and the Lord wants them to prepare war. China, America, Russia, Syria, France, Great Britain, Iran, Saudi Arabia: they all have to go to war. All you military men, wake up. It is time to go to Armageddon.

“Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.” Make weapons; you finished boot camp, now go to war. “Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.” Wake up, Esau; wake up, Ishmael. The valley of Jehoshaphat is the valley of decision, and they have to go there and die.

“Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe”; “for their wickedness is great. Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.” The nations arrayed against Babylon are the sword of the Lord bringing his vengeance on her.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 51:5
precepts.why:
Jeremiah 50 ends with the hammer of the whole earth broken: “Therefore hear ye the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out”. The least of the flock is the so-called Israelis, that tiny speck in the midst of the brown and black nations. They bomb Qatar during peace talks, cry help us, and America comes to their rescue. “surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them”: America desolate, and little Israel over there wiped out too. “At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.”

Then chapter 51 turns to us: “For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the Lord of hosts”. That means us. It might seem like we have been forsaken because we are down and out, at the bottom. But Israel has not been forsaken, because of the covenant the Lord made with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, and he sent his Son Christ to die for our sins.

“though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.” Even in the midst of our sin he has not forsaken us. That is the same mercy the class read in Isaiah 14:1, the Lord will have mercy on Jacob and will yet choose Israel, and nobody has anything to say about it. He is not having mercy on all nations or pardoning all nations; while Babylon, the hammer, is broken, Israel and Judah are kept.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 51:41-49
precepts.why:
“How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised!” Sheshach is another name for Babylon. America is the praise of the whole earth; everybody has God bless America. “how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!” All the nations will be shocked when she goes down.

“The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.” The sea is the nations. Ezekiel says it: “will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.” “Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.” That has not happened yet; it is yet to come.

“And I will punish Bel in Babylon”. Bel was a false god, and the Bel of today is Cesare Borgia, the god of Babylon. “and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him”: in Daniel 2 the last kingdom was a mix of all nations, and that is America. God will put an end to that. “yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.”

“My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the Lord.” Revelation 18:4 says the same: come out of her, that ye be not partakers of her sins and receive not of her plagues, those nuclear bombs. Come out of Christmas, Easter, Kwanzaa, Memorial Day and all the foolishness done here, and return to the one true God by keeping his commandments.

“And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour”. Do not give up. A rumour is something heard and talked about that has not occurred yet: World War III and Armageddon are the rumour now, the wars and rumours of wars of Matthew 24:6. Then “violence in the land, ruler against ruler.” “Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north”, as the whole earth breaks forth into singing in Isaiah 14:7. “As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.”

precepts.label: Jeremiah 51:7
precepts.why:
“How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!” This Babylon is America, and the hammer of the whole earth is America, the oppressor. The same way the Lord used Nebuchadnezzar to judge Israel and all the nations, he uses America in these last days to beat all nations into subjection and bring judgment on them. America is no longer acting as Lucifer, the one about peace, justice and rights; it is turning back into who it really is, and it will oppress all nations, including Europe.

“Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand”. In whose hand? The Lord's. The Lord is the one using Babylon. Everything Babylon does, everything Trump is doing on the earth today, is because the Lord wants it done. “that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine”. That wine is oppression, affliction, falsehood, lies and deceit: the same cup the Lord told Jeremiah to make all nations drink.

“therefore the nations are mad.” Europe, China, Russia, Iran, the Arab nations, Venezuela: they are angry. America went into a sovereign country, took its leader, brought him back on drug charges and had four billion dollars' worth of oil shipped over. That is the cup, and Venezuela will not be the only one to drink it; even if they do not want to, the Lord will make them drink.

That is why the hammer will be greatly despised and broken. This is the beginning of sorrows; the world has changed and it is not going to get better. Prepare your mind and your spirit, and stop being caught up in sin.

precepts.label: Isaiah 42:22
precepts.why:
“The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.” A narrow-minded person thinks only of the fields, but look at the economic and resource oppression on the continents where we reside: both kingdoms, all twelve tribes, suffering the same afflictions. They hold us fast because of the resources in our lands.

Isaiah describes that same people: “But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.” Robbed and spoiled is the same as the oppression we read of in Micah.

Robbed goes to our identity, not only our resources. The thesaurus lays it out: cut off, deprived, destitute, dispossessed; and because we are not living as the sons of God, we accept what they call us, Gentiles, and become impoverished, without hope, without a redeemer, without access to our own resources, stripped. Spoiled, in the sense meant here, is being severely damaged or harmed in a way that reduces value: marred or ruined. We are the sons of God, the greatest people the Lord ever created, for whom he made the whole earth, and that is not what we reap now.

“none delivereth”, “none saith, Restore”: that is why our Redeemer must come and do it. “Their Redeemer is strong; the Lord of hosts is his name”, and that Redeemer is Christ. Notice all the re- words with Israel: redeemed, restored, redemption. They show the covenant never passed on to some strangers or foreign nation. Our people have got to wake up.

precepts.label: Ecclesiastes 10:7
precepts.why:
Israel is a people robbed and spoiled, and spoiled means severely damaged or harmed in a way that reduces value, marred or ruined. Solomon gives the picture of it: “There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, as an error which proceedeth from the ruler: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.”

Folly is set in great dignity: the foolish things, the vessels of wrath, raised up high. And the rich sit in low place: the real rich, the ones the Lord speaks to in Revelation, knowing their poverty and their sufferings, yet calling them rich. Israel is rich, yet sits low.

“I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.” Those who were meant to serve us are in positions of authority and high value, and the princes, the sons of God, walk as servants upon the earth. If that's not the visual for spoiled when you read robbed and spoiled, nothing is.

That is the oppression of Jeremiah 50:33: Israel and Judah held fast by those who took them captive. And that is why none can restore it but the Redeemer who will plead their cause and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

precepts.label: Isaiah 66:15
precepts.why:
“For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.” He comes as a whirlwind, with chariots, and his rebuke is with fire. Read on: “For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh”.

Now go back to Jeremiah 50:35 and you can visualize the sword: “A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the Lord, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.” The Chaldeans are the elite of the Babylonians, but it is not just the upper echelon. It is all the inhabitants of Babylon, including the Israelites that do not repent.

The sword is “upon their horses, and upon their chariots”: their tanks and planes. It is “upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her”. Is this not the great melting pot, full of thick clay heaped upon itself with all types of nations? “a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.” What they did to us will happen to them.

It is “the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols”: crazy for their idols, from the money to the structure in DC to Christianity to Americanism and the flag they wave everywhere. The fire and the sword of the Lord in Isaiah 66 is the judgment coming upon that Babylon.

precepts.label: Isaiah 13:19
precepts.why:
Jeremiah says the sword upon Babylon ends in this: “it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation. As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the Lord; so shall no man abide there”. Once the smoke and smoulder of the nuclear destruction is there, only wild beasts will be able to dwell there.

Isaiah says the same thing and tells you who it is: “And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation”. The glory of kingdoms tells you who this is.

That is the key point. Did Sodom and Gomorrah exist after that? No. That did not happen to the physical Babylon at that time. It got some of these judgments as other empires came up over it, but it was never wiped out like Sodom. So either the Bible is lying and the prophecy did not come true, or it is talking about something else, for a different time.

It is speaking of Babylon the great today, the glory of kingdoms, the one full of mingled people and mad upon its idols: the United States. Her ultimate destruction will be as Sodom and Gomorrah.

thread.label: Jeremiah 51:7
thread.text: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 25:15
precepts.why:
The Lord told Jeremiah, “Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.” All the nations are made to drink of that cup.

Then Jeremiah 51:7 tells you whose hand the cup is in: “Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, that made all the earth drunken”. Babylon is America. The Babylon of these days is not just ancient Babylon; it is America. The same cup the Lord told Jeremiah to pour on all the nations is in Babylon's hand, and the Lord is using America, its administration, as his sword to bring judgment on the earth. Whoever sits in office, the next one will take over and it goes on.

That golden cup goes into oppression: falsehood, lies, oppression. “the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.” What is in the cup is not just riches but America's wrath and ill dealing, like going into Venezuela, taking its president, and then having millions of barrels of oil, about four billion dollars' worth, sent to America as tribute. That is why the nations all over the world are becoming angry with America.

precepts.label: Revelation 16:12

Ezekiel 36:20 says that when Israel was scattered among the heathen “they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the Lord, and are gone forth out of his land.” Every black and Latino Christian who points at the people in the land and says, those are the Jews, profanes God’s name. It was prophesied that the Messiah would come through Edom’s religion, Christianity, as a lord bent on doing away with all moral restraints: keep no commandments, keep no laws. That is the religion of Edom, and Christ is its enemy.

thread.text: The hand of the Lord was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the Lord, and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones,

precepts.label: Psalms 23:4
precepts.why:
Ezekiel was set down “in the midst of the valley which was full of bones”, and they were “very dry.” A valley full of bones is a graveyard. Very dry means no nourishment, no understanding, no water. David names that same valley: “Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.”

That was a rap lyric, huh? Shame on you. That is in the Bible. It is not Coolio and it is not Tupac. The world took the words of the famous Christian prayer and made a song of them, but the valley of the shadow of death is a real place in the scripture.

It is the same darkness Job spoke about in Job 10:21 and 22. It is the same land Baruch spoke of earlier, where our people wax old and are defiled with the dead in a strange land. And it is the same place Isaiah speaks of when the Lord comes to bring out “them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.” The valley of dry bones, the valley of the shadow of death, the land of darkness and the prison house are all one place: the lands of our captivity.

So the valley Ezekiel walked round about is where our people are today, dead and dry in a strange land. Yet even there the one who walks with the Lord fears no evil, because the Lord is with him, and it is the Lord who will bring those bones to life.

precepts.label: Proverbs 21:16
precepts.why:
The bones in the valley were “very dry”: no nourishment, no understanding, no water. Solomon shows how a people come to be counted among the dead: “The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.”

That is our people. When we got conquered and overthrown and colonised by our oppressors, over the course of time up until now, we wandered out of understanding, and now we are the congregation of the dead. It is the same as waxing old and being defiled with the dead in a strange land.

We are a spiritually dead people. Alive and well on the outside, but inside we are dead: destroyed, divisive, self-defeating, self-hating, self-detrimental. That is why the bones are dry.

So when the Lord asks, “Son of man, can these bones live?”, the answer is the understanding we wandered away from. Ezekiel is told, “O ye dry bones, hear the word of the Lord.” What must be brought to these bones is the word of God, not the word of some hustler, some ex-pimp, some pastor, preacher or rapper. The words of the Bible. The breath is the word of God, and only that understanding can bring the congregation of the dead back to life.

Nebuchadnezzar told Ashpenaz to bring “certain of the children of Israel, and of the king’s seed, and of the princes; Children in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science”. The ones they left behind were not the same, and that is why you see Africa the way it is.

The hearings they read say it: within the Negro population of the United States, the Negro working class is destined to be the vanguard of all liberation movements, and a strong Negro movement in the USA will be able to influence and direct the Negro movement in all those backward parts of the world. See what they called all the other places: backward parts of the earth. That is why Esau always has his eye on the American blacks. Canada and Europe have free healthcare and America does not, because they don't want the American blacks to get it; this group here is more dangerous than all the other groups.

That is why the Lord said: “The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first”. That is what the white man knows. It isn't Judah over in Africa; it isn't Judah in Saudi Arabia. It's Judah here, and the Lord is going to raise them up first.

So be proud of this history. Don't be mad; be glad. Sisters, don't just let your boys run out: the white man has his eyes on your sons, because they know what stock they come from. Even if the father was no good, the son is still of good stock, and there is still hope for him.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 33:7
precepts.why:
The hearings said the American Negro is the one who is going to lead all the others, the vanguard of the liberation movement on an international scale. The Bible said it first: “And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people”.

Judah is going to be the one teaching and preaching, and he is the one who is going to know where the tribes are. “let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.”

That is why, as in Daniel, the captor chose the best of the children of Israel, the king's seed and the princes, and brought them into the land. Esau took the best stock and put them in North America, and the American Economic Association wrote that the Negro stock landed in America was physically superior to the average of that left behind, the soundest and strongest, who transmitted to their offspring their qualities. We didn't write that; the white man wrote that. Judah in America is the one the Lord brings unto his people and helps from his enemies.

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 26:19-21
precepts.why:
Babylon chose children of Israel “in whom was no blemish”, and the white man's own books say the stock landed in America was the soundest and strongest. A lot of our women don't understand this. “My son, keep the flower of thine age sound; and give not thy strength to strangers.” Don't give your strength to other nations, or to wicked women.

“When thou hast gotten a fruitful possession through all the field, sow it with thine own seed”: sow with thine own race. “trusting in the goodness of thy stock.” That's some good stock right there, and some of you are ashamed of it.

“So thy race which thou leavest shall be magnified, having the confidence of their good descent.” You didn't know the word race was in the Bible, in terms of ethnicity, in terms of your nationality. This is what your sons and daughters have to know, instead of running around giving their seed to any old thing out there in the world.

And don't hold your breath for reparations. Esau is not stupid. After slavery we had no reparations and still built great, advanced societies without white folks, and they came up with a reason to drop dynamite on us and destroy them, even Seneca Village in Central Park. Trust in the goodness of your stock: we can build without them.

thread.label: Daniel 2:40
thread.text: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things: and as iron that breaketh all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.

classes.title: Civil War & the Son of Perdition

precepts.label: Luke 11:17
precepts.why:
The fourth kingdom “shall be strong as iron” is Rome, and Europe and America are the extension of Rome. Strong as iron means strong militarily. But Daniel goes on: in the feet and toes, “part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron”. They have that same military strength Rome had, yet “the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.” Why broken? Because they are divided. That is what you see taking place right now: America is divided.

Christ said it: “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.” A lot of times we use this for when we were divided in Jerusalem, and it is. But it is also speaking of the last days, of the kingdom that is set up in the last days, and it tells us what happens before its destruction.

Read on: “If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand?” Which kingdom is Satan's kingdom? Europe and America. America and Europe are divided; that alliance is falling apart. Here in America the citizens are divided. Satan is divided against himself, and that is a sign that they are about to fall. How can his kingdom stand? It can't.

The same division is prophesied of Egypt, and America is spiritually called Egypt: “I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.” White people will be fighting white people, city against city, the same way the South fought against the North in the Civil War. The Lord is behind all of it.

So the iron kingdom of Daniel 2:40 is strong, but its own division is what brings it to desolation. The civil war things are already going on, even in the drawing of new districts between Texas and California to hold the House and the Senate. Pay attention: a house divided against a house falls.

precepts.label: Proverbs 21:1
precepts.why:
Daniel says “the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will”, and Solomon shows how: “The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.” God turns the king's heart wherever he will. Whatever the Lord wants the king to do, he is going to do it.

So even in these last days, God gave who is ruling the world today. America is the superpower, and God put Trump in that position. Everything you see Trump doing today, God is allowing it. He is snatching people up off the street and sending them to prisons in other countries, and that is not outside the hand of the Most High.

This answers the question our people ask: why is God allowing Trump to do the things being done on the earth? Because the heart of that king is in the Lord's hand, and the Most High is setting up over the kingdom of men whom he will, even “the basest of men”, to bring his judgment to pass.

precepts.label: Psalms 17:13
precepts.why:
Why is God allowing Trump to do what he is doing? David answers it: “Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword”. The wicked is God's sword. The so-called white man is God's sword.

So when the Most High sets up “the basest of men” over the kingdom of men, he is taking up his sword. The wicked are not ruling on their own power; they are the weapon in God's hand, the same way the king's heart is in the hand of the Lord.

And the prayer shows what the righteous do while that sword is out: cry to the Lord to deliver our souls from the wicked. The sword is being used for judgment on the earth, and only the Lord can deliver his people from it.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 46:16
precepts.why:
“He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.” The oppressing sword is the wicked, the sword of Psalms 17:13. And an oppressing sword is being risen up all over the earth, especially on the western hemisphere, and especially amongst our people.

Everything you see taking place with ICE, with how America went into Venezuela and snatched up its president, Trump telling the leader in Colombia he is next: that is the oppressing sword. We are living in the beginning of sorrows. It is going to get worse and worse, beyond the worst things you could think of. You thought World War II was bad; wait till you see what is about to happen on this earth. Don't sit back and be comfortable because nothing has happened to you yet.

God is using America, that administration, as his sword to bring judgment on the earth. It is the wine cup of Jeremiah 25:15: “Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.” And Jeremiah 51:7 shows whose hand that cup is in: “Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.” Babylon is not just ancient Babylon; it is America. What is in that cup is falsehood, lies, oppression and ill dealing, and that is why the nations are becoming angry with America.

So under that oppressing sword, many fall, and the cry goes up: “let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity”. This is why Daniel 4:17 matters now: the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, he has raised up the wicked as his sword over this side of the world where Israel is, and he is using it to bring judgment on the earth.

precepts.label: Isaiah 45:14
precepts.why:
The second beast is “like to a bear”, and the bear is the Persians and the Medes. “it raised up itself on one side”: Persia raised itself up, because through King Cyrus, Persia became mightier than Media. “and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it”. What three nations do those ribs represent? Isaiah 45:14 answers: “Thus saith the Lord, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans”. The three ribs are Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans, the nations Persia conquered.

This kingdom of Persia and Media is very significant for what is going on today. The Achaemenid Empire of Old Persian was an ancient Iranian empire, founded by Cyrus the Great in 550 BC. The bear of Daniel 7 is Iran.

And the Lord worked through that Persian king. “the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia”, and Cyrus proclaimed, “The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.” The Lord spoke to him, and he listened. Isaiah says of him, “He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.” And the chapter of the three ribs opens, “Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him”.

So the Lord used King Cyrus, a Persian, to let us go back and build the temple, and gave him Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans to devour. That is why the bear rose up on one side, and why the land of Persia, Iran, stands in prophecy for the days we are in.

precepts.label: Daniel 7:19-20
precepts.why:
Daniel asks to know “the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass”. The fourth beast is the fourth kingdom to rise up and rule the earth: it began with Rome, and Europe and America are the extension of Rome. The beast is Edom, the so-called white man.

“And of the ten horns that were in his head, and of the other which came up, and before whom three fell”. The ten horns are the Europeans; when the European Union was first formed it was ten nations, though today it is much more than that. The other horn that came up among them is America, and the three that fell before it are the powers America fought for its independence: France, Spain and Britain. This year America turns 250 years old.

“even of that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things”. Look at the back of the dollar bill: the eye of a man set in the top of the pyramid, separated from the rest of it so it looks like a horn, with light illuminating all around it. It is not only the eye of Ra; they put the eyes of a man there. Those eyes are this man's wisdom and his technology, the wisdom Satan gave him. And it is his claim to be God: God sees everything everyone does, and the white man sets himself up as God and says, I see everything.

The great mouth speaks great things: he calls himself the people of God, calls himself a Jew, and says the land of Israel belongs to him. America has spoken many great things against God. And the great mouth is his power to communicate, to speak from one side of the world to the other.

“whose look was more stout than his fellows”: America is stronger than all the European nations. Why? Because of the technology, because of that great mouth and those eyes. Ezekiel shows the same wisdom in the prince of Tyrus, a rich ancient city on the coast of Lebanon that God uses as an analogy for America: “thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God”, “yet thou art a man, and not God”. “Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee”. With the technology we have, you can talk to someone on the other side of the world and see him on a device. There is no secret you can hide from the white man; every evil you do, everything you buy, he sees it.

“By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches”: that is how America became rich, through its technology and trade, the system that made the American dollar the dominant dollar in the world. But because he has set his heart “as the heart of God”, God says, “I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom”. That is future prophecy.

precepts.label: Daniel 9:27
precepts.why:
“the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision”. Who are the robbers of God's people? Daniel 9:27 shows what they do: “And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease”. “and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate”: he set up abomination and made our people desolate, meaning he destroyed our people, “even until the consummation”. That is why the Greeks, and the white man after them, are called the abomination of desolation, the abomination that maketh desolate. They are the robbers of God's people.

The Greeks wanted to conquer and take the land of Israel, and not only the land. First Maccabees 3 shows they took the book of the law and painted their likeness and their images in it, robbing us of our culture too. Judas Maccabeus rose up and fought against them.

And it is not only the Greeks. Christ said, “When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place”. In the time of the Greeks the abomination was the Greeks; in the time of Christ it was the Romans; and Europe is an extension of Rome. In 1949 Europeans from Germany, Poland, Russia and Ukraine went into the holy land saying, we are the people of God. Today the abomination of desolation is those people in the land calling themselves Jews and they are not: the Europeans, the Edomites. Why are they called that? Because they destroy everything; ask the Palestinians.

When they stand in the holy place, “then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.” They are the ones who will instigate it. But Daniel 11:14 ends, “but they shall fall.” The same way they fell back then is the same way they are going to fall today.

“so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God”: his temples are the temples of God. “shewing himself that he is God”: all his images show him as God, as the Son of God, as the angels, as the Jews. What we read in 2 Thessalonians 2 is the same thing Daniel prophesied the white man would do.

thread.text: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.

precepts.label: Hosea 9:13-14
precepts.why:
“Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.” Think of a pancake: the top is white and the bottom is brown. We still have that, but you have a lot of light skin, and it was strategic. The whitening campaigns across Latin America were a war on blackness, meant to make us forget our heritage: grandmothers praising good hair and light babies, textbooks erasing black heroes, children taught not to embrace their nose, their lips or their skin. That is how you colonize a people from the inside out. This devil is very evil and very strategic, but there is a God.

“Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.” The pleasant place is the island of Puerto Rico. Ephraim and Manasseh are Joseph. “Give them, O Lord: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.”

A lot of misinformed and uneducated people think the northern kingdom is not Israel just because they are light-skinned. No. The Lord knows exactly who they are, and the Lord made sure the seed would continue. It doesn't matter if they are light or dark; the Lord knows who is who, just as he knew that Asher would land in Brazil, and Brazil is Hebrew for iron. The Lord didn't make a mistake.

So the cake not turned is still Ephraim. Mixed among the people and whitened on top, brought forth to the murderer in a pleasant place, the northern kingdom is still the children of Israel, and the curses on them prove it.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:33
precepts.why:
“The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway”. We are reaping what we have sown, especially the northern kingdom. Hosea 9 says we went a whoring from our God: we sought after the other nations and their ideals and made deals with them, and so “Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.” That is servitude, dependence, and our resources consumed by others.

The oil, the land, the assets: everything the nations say we stole from them is really the fruit of our land, eaten up by a nation we knew not. Others eat our labour. That is what the whole documentary The End of Poverty is about.

The other nations are the ministers of evil unto us for the evil that we have done. Just as there is prophecy for Babylon that great city, there is prophecy for us, and this is it: oppressed and crushed alway, in Venezuela, Cuba, and all through Latin America.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:48
precepts.why:
“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” This is for the northern kingdom especially. Our breakdown of it has often been very United States based, but when you go to these other countries you have to give the sense this way, because the people there are fully aware of the robbing of their resources.

Why these things in particular, hunger, thirst, nakedness and want of all things? Ecclesiasticus (Sirach) 39:26 names the chief things of life: “The principal things for the whole use of man’s life are water, fire, iron, and salt, flour of wheat, honey, milk, and the blood of the grape, and oil, and clothing.” When you target those things you dehumanize a people, taking away what is needful for them to live dignified. That is why they will never let the resources in their backyard be controlled by the people who own them, here or in Africa. “All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.” Because we have not repented of what Hosea 9 describes, we will not reclaim them until the Redeemer comes; in the meantime we must repent and keep the laws, statutes and commandments.

Sirach 34:21 shows it is violence: “The bread of the needy is their life: he that defraudeth him thereof is a man of blood.” You think violence has to be a sword, a bomb or a bullet, but “he that defraudeth the labourer of his hire is a bloodshedder.” The man in the documentary worked all day and still had nothing to go home to eat.

Lamentations 5 is the same picture: “Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.” “We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.” You see it now in Cuba, in Venezuela, in parts of Africa. “We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread”, just as Hosea 9 says: we have given the power and sovereignty of our resources to Babylon the Great, the United States, and other nations, and China is working its way into Latin America. “Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.” With the Monroe Doctrine, the Roosevelt Corollary and the big stick, the northern kingdom is still paying for the sins of the forefathers. “Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.”

Chains do not have to be chains anymore; this is economic slavery, and that is why Deuteronomy 28:48 is so profound. Baruch 3:8: “we are yet this day in our captivity”, “to be subject to payments, according to all the iniquities of our fathers, which departed from the Lord our God.” That is the key. We need this compassion to reach in and touch our people's souls. Babylon is speaking plainly; so must we.

thread.label: Hosea 11:10
thread.text: They shall walk after the Lord: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.

precepts.label: Isaiah 43:5
precepts.why:
Hosea says the Lord “shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.” The west is the western hemisphere, where the tribes are primarily scattered.

Isaiah says the same: “Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west”. The Lord gathers his children from where they are, and the west is where most of them are, here in America and this side of the world.

So when the Lord roars, the children who tremble and walk after him come from the west, and he gathers them. That is the hope for the tribes over here, but it comes with a warning. Before this the class read that Babylon's “sins have reached unto heaven”, and that we must come out of the ways of America and out of her idolatry. If we don't repent of our stubbornness, our bullheadedness and our idolatry, we will get the same judgment as her. The seed that is gathered from the west is the seed that answers the roar and walks after the Lord.

precepts.label: Zechariah 8:7-8
precepts.why:
“Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country”. The children who tremble from the west in Hosea are the ones the Lord saves from the west country. “And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”

Remember what the Jewish Encyclopedia said earlier in the class about Arzareth: the land beyond the great river, far from the habitation of man, where the ten tribes of Israel would dwell observing the laws of Moses until the time of the restoration, and Columbus identified America with that land. It was prophesied that we would be over here until the time of restoration. This is that restoration: the Lord bringing us from the west country to dwell in the midst of Jerusalem.

And it is “in truth and in righteousness”. That is why the class closed on idolatry: “the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil”, and our stubbornness and disdain for God's commandments are idolatry. Flee from idolatry, so that you are among the people he brings back.

thread.label: Joel 3:1-8
thread.text: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,

precepts.label: Jeremiah 30:3
precepts.why:
Joel opens with “in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem”. Jeremiah shows what that means: “For, lo, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith the Lord: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.”

To bring again the captivity is to bring us back to our homeland, the land given to our fathers, and to possess it. That is the evidence. Now we know what Joel 3:1 is saying.

And it ties the whole chapter together. The Most High gathers all nations into the valley of Jehoshaphat, in Israel, at the place called Har-Megiddo, where the name Armageddon comes from, to plead with them for his people and his heritage Israel, whom they scattered among the nations while they parted his land between the Arabs and the Edomites.

Joel ends the same way it begins: “Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them”. The Most High raises up the Israelites out of the places they were sold into, back to verse 1, and brings us home to our land in freedom.

precepts.label: Amos 1:9-10
precepts.why:
Joel asks, “what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine?” and charges them: “The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians”. Amos says the same of Tyre: “For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant”.

The same people delivered us to Edom, whom Joel calls the Grecians: the white man. Tyre and Zidon were the Hamite nations of Canaan back then, and the coasts of Palestine, the ancient Philistines, is the modern name for the modern people there, the Arabs. They cast lots for our people, bid on us the way it is still done in the Arab countries, gave a boy for an harlot, making the men into breeders, and sold a girl for wine. They took our silver and gold and robbed our temples.

“But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof.” The wall of Tyrus is the land, and you see that land catching hell today, and the Arabs are there too.

That is the recompence Joel speaks of: what you did to my people, I will have done to you. They recompensed the Most High by selling us as slaves, so he will sell their sons and daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off. Eye for eye, tooth for tooth. “For the Lord hath spoken it”, and Christians cannot change this Bible.

thread.label: Obadiah 1:11-14
thread.text: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.

precepts.label: 1 Esdras 4:45
precepts.why:
Obadiah is “concerning Edom”: the whole chapter is about Edom and what they did. “In the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.” Even Edom was as one of them. First Esdras names the deed plainly: “Thou also hast vowed to build up the temple, which the Edomites burned when Judea was made desolate by the Chaldees.”

So who burned the temple? The Edomites. The history agrees: when the first temple was destroyed in 586 BC, Edom aided the Babylonian Empire rather than helping Judah, their brother. They rejoiced, looted the city, blocked the survivors fleeing, and took part in razing Solomon's temple. The brother of the Israelites assisted the Babylonians, which were Cushites, in destroying the first temple.

That is every charge in Obadiah. “Thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger”: the twelve tribes did become strangers. “Neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction”: they rejoiced when we got destroyed. They “laid hands on their substance”: they were robbing us too. They “stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape”: when we were escaping, Edom blocked our way, held us in, and gave us up to the Babylonians.

That is why the Psalm cries, “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” Rase it: destroy it. That is what Edom did when they burned down that temple, and it is why Edom is called the daughter of Babylon, because they assisted the Cushite Babylonians: “O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed”.

thread.label: Micah 1:1
thread.text: The word of the Lord that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

precepts.label: Acts 13:1
precepts.why:
“Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger”. Right there among the prophets and teachers of the church is a man called Niger. It was never derogatory. It was a name for our people, used in the church itself, set alongside Barnabas, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen and Saul.

That is the same thing as Micah the Morasthite in Micah 1:1. The word Moor is in the Bible: Micah, teacher of the Moors. These names were ours, and they described our people plainly. The names that came later were put on us by others: the Latins, who later became the Romans, gave the name Africa to the region around Carthage and Utica. Africa was a term that came way later.

So we have to go back to the name God calls us. Simeon called Niger and Micah the Morasthite were Israelites, teachers and prophets of our people, and the scriptures show them to us by those names without any shame in them.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 26:18
precepts.why:
Jeremiah names the same prophet: “Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.”

It confirms Micah 1:1: the word of the Lord came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Hezekiah, king of Judah, and it was a word against Jerusalem. Morasthite: the Moor is in the Bible, and Micah was a teacher of the Moors.

And what Micah prophesied is what happened to us, over and over. Anytime we are set somewhere, we rise up as a nation, and the Lord allows Esau to conquer us. Why? Because the savior is Christ. If we could do it without Christ, why would we need Christ? The Moors went into Europe in 710 AD and brought universities, soap, the holy waters that became rubbing alcohol, strawberries, olives and grapes, wine, even chess; then they were conquered and scattered, many sent to Africa and transported to Brazil and North America. Zion plowed like a field, Jerusalem become heaps.

precepts.label: 2 Chronicles 3:1
precepts.why:
This shows that the hill of the Morasthites was part of Jerusalem: “Then Solomon began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the Lord appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.” Moriah: Moor right there, black again.

The reference work read in class says the same. Moriah was a hill adjacent to Jerusalem, on the northeast. There Abraham offered his son, in Genesis 22, and when Solomon built the temple on it, it became included in the city.

So the temple of the Lord stood on the hill of the Moors, and Micah the Morasthite, the teacher of the Moors, was a prophet of that same people. The Moors were Israelites; the names Moors and Africa came later, but the land and the house of the Lord tie them to Jerusalem.

precepts.label: Luke 4:6
precepts.why:
“Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.” Upon their beds means they are insulated from consequence; they know nobody can touch them, like Trump saying in his first term he could shoot somebody on Fifth Avenue and nobody would do anything. When the morning is light, they do it through institutions, laws and bills stacked higher than a ream of paper, with billions in them for Israel and Ukraine. They are vessels of wrath fitted for destruction, and that is our hope: all that wrath will be paid back to them double.

Why is it in the power of their hand? Luke shows who gave it. After showing Christ all the kingdoms, “the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.”

To whomsoever I will, I give it. So who gave them their power? Satan. And who are the ministers of Satan? Babylon the great, Esau: what the world ignorantly calls the white man.

That is why they covet fields, oil fields, iron ore fields, rare earth fields, agricultural fields, and take them by violence, as with Venezuela. The power in their hand was delivered to them by the devil.

precepts.label: Job 9:24
precepts.why:
It is given into his hand to do these things. Job says it: “The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?” It goes with Micah 2 and with Luke 4:6.

He covers the faces of the judges: the real judges, which are the Israelites. And “if not, where, and who is he?” If it is not given to him, then who is he? If it is not this man, who is it?

Look at their conferences: the United Nations, the G8, the economic forums, diverse nations in a room together and Israel not represented. When these prophecies were revealed to our forefathers, they were seeing visuals of things like this: the halls and conference centers of all the nations taking crafty counsel together about world domination.

It reinforces even more that only Christ can save us from this. There is no way to play in their sandbox, in their politics. No leader will rise up and combat what they have done, because the earth has been given into the hand of the wicked.

precepts.label: Psalms 94:20
precepts.why:
When the morning is light they practise it, and they do it through law. “Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?”

That is how the whole system was designed. The Constitution was not framed for us; we were three-fifths of a man. It was based on Roman and Greek democracy, which you read of in the Maccabees, and even then we were not part of it. It was framed to keep them in power. The Supreme Court interprets Esau's constitution, and it is all set up with words that frame mischief to benefit them. Our salvation is not in that.

Look at it now: the Supreme Court, 6 to 3, on its shadow docket, behind closed doors, gave ICE the green light to stop and detain people based on appearance, language, accent or workplace. That is racial profiling blessed by law, and it targets the northern kingdom. So if you are a citizen and you fit the profile, carry your passport or a passport card.

Sanctions, asset seizures, blockades: all of that is violence too, economic violence. When you oppress a man and his house and his heritage, whether you take him by the neck or frame a law, it is still violence. If what they want is not legal, they find a way to weaponize the legal system. That is the throne of iniquity.

thread.label: Micah 2:2
thread.text: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 6:55
precepts.why:
Micah says, “they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” Even a man and his heritage: these lands were given to us by God. Ezra says why: “All this have I spoken before thee, O Lord, because thou madest the world for our sakes”.

For whose sake? Our sake. Not everybody's sake: our sake. The enemy knows that. Esau knows that the world was made for our sake, so he has to create laws to remove us, set puppet presidents up, and pass laws against us.

That is how they covet the fields. They want our lands; they want to be the landlords. They take them by any means necessary: by fires, by earthquakes, by murder, deception, creating laws and setting up puppet presidents. They take our houses, and that is why we migrate and get displaced: our lands are burned and destroyed and taken from us for the precious resources, the minerals underneath. So they oppress an Israelite man and his house, where he is from and where he lives.

Now they give visas to Israeli nationals, who come to our lands and buy up property. When we go to Ecuador, Peru and Guatemala, you see them coming in on free visas, allowed to buy property, while the people of the land have to jump through hoops and hurdles just to keep the lot they have. In Argentina the laws were changed so that foreigners could buy land, and the state of Israel is buying up land at cheap prices. It is the heritage God gave us, and the world made for our sakes, that they are after.

thread.label: Habakkuk 1:10
thread.text: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.

precepts.label: Sirach 12:10
precepts.why:
Habakkuk says, “they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them”. That is how America and Europe are: they went into Venezuela and took a sitting president. “For they shall heap dust, and take it”: dust is confusion. Say he is a drug dealer bringing fentanyl to America, and then take him. “Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend”. Sirach warns us what that change is worth: “Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.”

America was always a violent people: they took this land from the North American Indians and put them on reservations, overthrew nations in South America, and went into Haiti in the early 1900s, took the gold and murdered the leaders. After 1945, when America became the world superpower and the head of the beast, it could not lead the world while still lynching and segregating openly. So it put on a new face of justice, peace and rights. That is why they gave civil rights, Section 8 and food stamps: not because they love you, but to pacify you. Now he is changing back to who he used to be. Make America great again means before the 60s.

You can shine a piece of iron and make it look good, but leave it over time and the rust appears. That is the white man's wickedness: it always comes back. “Though he humble himself, and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him”. In the civil rights movement he humbled himself, marched with us and said sorry for what his forefathers did, but “his rust hath not been altogether wiped away.” That is why people are surprised at the KKK, the Nazi supremacists and ICE. The Constitution was written when you was a slave, and it counted you three-fifths of a man.

“Set him not by thee, lest, when he hath overthrown thee, he stand up in thy place”: do not make marriages with him and his woman. It happened in South Africa and in South American countries. After the civil rights era many of us forgot who the enemy was; some even have kids by him and say they love him, but God says never trust your enemy. “Who will pity a charmer that is bitten with a serpent”? The serpent is your enemy. If you go and befriend him and get bitten, nobody will pity you. We warned you.

precepts.label: 1 Esdras 5:72-73
precepts.why:
Haggai brings the word to Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the high priest: “This people say, The time is not come, the time that the Lord’s house should be built.” Why were they saying that? First Esdras shows what was happening: “But the heathen of the land lying heavy upon the inhabitants of Judea, and holding them strait, hindered their building”.

They were hindering the building of the temple. “And by their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building all the time that king Cyrus lived: so they were hindered from building for the space of two years, until the reign of Darius.” See that: secret plots, persuading the multitude to go against us, causing commotions.

So everybody was discouraged, with all the other nations hindering them, and they said, maybe this is not the time for the temple to be built. Zerubbabel and Joshua stopped building. Then God raised up Haggai and Zechariah to blast the high priest and the governor so they would go back to the work, and they finished it in the sixth year of the reign of Darius.

That is why it is important to read your four chapters a day. Captains, make sure your soldiers are reading, so they graduate properly at the end of the year having read the whole Bible; then you know the history behind a verse like Haggai 1:2. And the lesson stands for us: the enemy's plots are no reason to let the Lord's house lie waste while we dwell in our cieled houses.

precepts.label: 2 Corinthians 13:5
precepts.why:
Haggai says, “Now therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts; Consider your ways.” Do you know what consider your ways means? Examine yourself. Paul says it: “Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?”

If you don't know Christ is in you, you are reprobate. That is what all of us have to do: examine ourselves day by day. And don't say consider your ways was only for Zerubbabel; it is not.

Haggai shows what happens when we don't. “Ye have sown much, and bring in little”: you worked a lot with little profit to show for it. “Ye eat, but ye have not enough ... and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes.” I just worked 48, 52 hours, and I don't have enough money to show for it. That was going on with Zerubbabel, and it is why many of us are always struggling: because God is second or third in your life, just like Zerubbabel. “Because of mine house that is waste, and ye run every man unto his own house.”

When Zerubbabel and Joshua heard it, they “obeyed the voice of the Lord their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet”. Haggai was not governor or high priest, but they humbled themselves, because they knew it was the word of the Lord. They did not say, arrest him. That is how we have to be. When we correct a brother he takes it personal, like we stabbed his mama; correct his wife and he says you are trying to destroy my marriage. No, we are trying to help. That's love. Examine yourself and fix your life.

precepts.label: Ezra 3:12-13
precepts.why:
“Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory? and how do ye see it now? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing?” They had been in Babylon for 70 years; Cyrus came in at the end of the 70 years, then Darius. So the question is, who is still alive that saw the temple Solomon built? When they rebuilt the temple, it did not look half as good as what Solomon had built.

Ezra shows those men: “But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice”. Old men who had seen Solomon's temple cried with a loud voice.

“and many shouted aloud for joy: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.” The young rejoiced at a foundation; the ancient men wept, because in their eyes it was as nothing in comparison to the first glory.

That house Zerubbabel rebuilt was completed around 515 BC, but it did not compare. That is why, in the time of Rome, Herod the Edomite would come and renovate it to make it look good.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 22:13
precepts.why:
The second temple did not look good in comparison to Solomon's, so King Herod the Great, around 20 to 19 BC, began a massive expansion and renovation: to beautify the site, impress the Roman world, and win favor with his Jewish subjects. He doubled the Temple Mount platform with giant retaining walls, used enormous white limestone blocks, some over 500 tons, trimmed the temple with gold, and added grand colonnades, entry gates and spacious public spaces for worshippers and pilgrims. That last part means the other nations now had a place to come and look at what was going on in the temple. That was not in the original design God gave us. Herod added it.

Jeremiah is read against that building: “Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; that useth his neighbour’s service without wages, and giveth him not for his work”.

Herod was an Idumean, an Edomite, despised by the Judahites because he was not one of their own stock. He hated the people of Judah, executed forty-five of their leaders, and destroyed the priestly line of Hyrcanus. All that building was to get in good graces, and it was built by unrighteousness and by wrong.

precepts.label: Matthew 11:12
precepts.why:
Herod the Edomite rebuilt the temple to win favor with the Jews and impress Rome. Christ spoke of what was happening in his day: “And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.”

Who are the violent Christ was talking about? Rome. Rome took the kingdom by force.

And in the years just before the time of Christ, Judea was controlled by an Edomite faction who usurped the Judahite name, land and heritage. Usurped the name means they became Jewish: we are converts, we are Jews now. That is what Herod was doing. Historically the Edomites became known as Jews, derived from Judea and from Judah, though they were never of Judah or Israel. The violent took the kingdom by force, and then they took the name.

precepts.label: John 10:10
precepts.why:
Christ said: “The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.” Who is he talking about? Rome. Remember, Herod was an Idumean, and Rome were Idumeans: they were the same race.

That thief stole the name. Their own book, written by Esau and not by a negro, says the Jews of today are of two types, the Sephardic and the Ashkenazi. Initially we were the Sephardim in Spain; when they conquered us and cast us out, Esau became the Sephardic ones. The Ashkenazi, 90 percent of the so-called Jews, came from the Khazars, and their own Jewish Encyclopedia says the Khazars are of Edomite stock, from the land of Edom. We had to find out whether they were Japheth or Esau, and their own sources answer it. We have second, third and fourth book sources, and the Bible is always our main source.

“Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.” God calls Edom “the people of my curse”. If God hated you and your ancestors, you would want to hide that you are Esau. That is why they claim to be Israel, form the Anti-Defamation League, push hate crime laws, and infiltrate the churches. The thief came to steal, kill and destroy; Christ came that we might have life.

thread.label: Zechariah 2:6-9
thread.text: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.

precepts.label: Psalms 78:68
precepts.why:
“Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord”: the land of the north is North America. “for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven.” Then: “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” Which Zion?

“But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.” The Lord chose the tribe of Judah, mount Zion. So we know that the Zion dwelling with the daughter of Babylon is Judah: deliver thyself, O Judah.

Benjamin does not dwell with the daughter of Babylon; they are on a nice, pleasant island. Levi does not dwell with the daughter of Babylon. That's why all the tribes make fun of Judah: we have places to go back to when we want to run; y'all have no place to go. Why? Because Judah dwells with the daughter of Babylon, with Edom, in North America.

“For thus saith the Lord of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye”: he that touches you touches my favorite. “For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants”: Edom shall be a spoil to us, and we are the servants here. “and ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me.”

precepts.label: Isaiah 11:12

People will hear us teaching and say, oh, you're saying all Judah is in North America. Zechariah is pointing out a remnant of Judah that is in North America. And what's so special about this group here? The house of David is here. You are going to find that thing out.

Why are they so hard on Judah here as opposed to Judah scattered elsewhere? The civil rights hearings of 1959 before the Senate, under the title American Negro problems, say it: the Negro question in the United States of America must be treated in its relation to the huge Negro masses oppressed and exploited by white imperialism in Africa and South America, and the Negroes of the United States are the most advanced section of the Negro population of the world and can play a decisive role in helping and leading the liberation movement of the Negro colonies. You have Negroes in Jamaica, Haiti, Africa, Saudi Arabia; Judah is everywhere, the southern kingdom is everywhere. But the white man examined all the Negro populations and said the American Negro is the most advanced.

Deacon Malachi brought it out: when Nebuchadnezzar came against Judah, they took the best of the best, the most educated. Esau isn't stupid; he knows that history.
