thread.label: Colossians 1:1-6
thread.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,

classes.title: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.label: Colossians 2:1
precepts.why:
Paul writes “To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse,” just as Ephesians is written to the saints at Ephesus. Same concept: these are Israelites in Asia. Then he says, “Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus.” What is Paul saying? He never went to Colosse. The spirit was so heavy in Ephesus that it spread all throughout Asia, and Paul heard there was another congregation over in Colosse that was fervent in spirit too, so he wrote to them.

Chapter 2 proves it: “For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh.” Why had they not seen Paul’s face? Because he never went to Laodicea, and he never went to Colosse. For anyone who wondered why there is no precept in Acts of Paul going to Colosse, that is the precept.

On the map, Ephesus is in the middle, Colosse to the right of it, Laodicea above it (the Laodicea you read about in Revelation), and Hierapolis, known as one of the wealthy cities of that region. The gospel spread through all those cities, “as it is in all the world.” Acts 19 says Paul turned away much people “not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia” from the goddess Diana, the woman all Asia worshipped, just as America worships the Virgin Mary. The spirit was so heavy on the apostle that places he never physically went to were getting touched.

thread.label: Colossians 1:7-8
thread.text: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;

classes.title: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.label: Acts 18:1-8
precepts.why:
The Colossians learned the truth “of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ.” That is how they woke up: one brother heard it and said, I am going to teach all of you. Acts 18 shows the same concept at Corinth: “After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth.”

“And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house.” If you were in the synagogue, you were practicing the law of sacrifice. Crispus was the chief ruler of it, and he believed on Christ, just like a lot of us were practicing Christianity and then believed. “And many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.” It started with him and then the others took hold of it.

Paul was actually at Corinth, though. With Epaphras it was different: he was a self-starter. He did not need someone right there to get the ground running. He said, that is true, I believe it, I am going to go teach it. That is just like today when somebody sees IUIC on YouTube, prints out flyers and starts hitting the city, and then this school pops up and that school pops up. We are the continuation of the acts of the apostles, and when we read these scriptures we have to put ourselves in them, because we are doing the exact same thing.

precepts.label: Colossians 4:12-13
precepts.why:
Epaphras, the “faithful minister of Christ” the Colossians learned from, comes up again at the end of the letter: “Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.”

“For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.” On the map you see Colosse, then Laodicea and Hierapolis, all in that same region. Epaphras was one of them, and he carried the work through all three cities.

Epaphras was putting in serious work. He heard the truth, believed it, taught it, and kept labouring fervently in prayer for the congregations he raised up, with great zeal for them. He is the example of the brother who takes the truth and gets the ground running in his own region.

precepts.label: Philemon 1:23-25
precepts.why:
In the epistle to Philemon, Epaphras shows up again: “There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus.” Paul calls Epaphras his fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus. But why is he mentioned in the letter to Philemon? Because Philemon was also of Colosse.

“Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.” Remember Demas: when you read Timothy, Demas forsook this truth. “The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.”

The letters Paul wrote from Rome to that region, Ephesians, Colossians and Philemon, overlap and name the same people because he wrote them at the same time and to the same place. Following Epaphras through them shows how the work in Colosse spread from one faithful brother to a whole company of labourers.

precepts.label: Philemon 1:1-2
precepts.why:
“Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer, And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house.”

Philemon was of Colosse, the same place Epaphras taught. So it started with Epaphras, and then others came: Philemon, a dearly beloved fellow labourer, Apphia, Archippus the fellow soldier, and a church meeting in Philemon’s house.

That is how the truth spreads. One brother, a faithful minister of Christ, wakes up and teaches, and then fellow labourers rise up around him and congregations meet in houses, the same way schools pop up one after another today.

precepts.label: Philemon 1:10
precepts.why:
“I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds.” Why would Paul write to Philemon on behalf of Onesimus? Because they had to be in the same place: Colosse.

Colossians 4:9 calls Onesimus “a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you,” one of the Colossians. And he is the same Onesimus Paul begot in his bonds and sent back to Philemon.

So the letters tie together. Epaphras, Philemon and Onesimus all belong to Colosse, and the epistles to the Colossians and to Philemon were carried to the same city, to the same congregation of Israelites that had learned the truth of Epaphras.

precepts.label: Colossians 4:18
precepts.why:
“The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.” Then the subscript many Bibles carry: “Written from Rome to the Colossians by Tychicus and Onesimus.” Some people’s Bibles may not have that line, so it was put up on the screen for everyone to see.

This epistle was written from Rome, while Paul was under house arrest, which parallels Acts 28, and sent to the church at Colosse by Tychicus and Onesimus. Ephesians, Colossians, Philemon, Philippians, 1 Timothy, Titus and 2 Timothy were written in that same time, which is why they overlap and speak of similar topics and the same people.

Paul never went to Colosse. He wrote to a congregation raised up by Epaphras, and sent the letter by brothers who were themselves of that city.

precepts.label: Colossians 4:7-10
precepts.why:
“All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord.” Tychicus carried the letter. “With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.” Onesimus was one of the Colossians.

“Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister’s son to Barnabas.” If Marcus is Barnabas’ sister’s son, that makes Marcus his nephew: John Mark.

That is the same John Mark that Paul and Barnabas had their dispute over at the end of Acts 15. Barnabas was sticking up for him because he was his nephew. So these closing names are not filler; they tie the letter to the history of the apostles and the men who carried the work.

precepts.label: Acts 15:37-41
precepts.why:
“And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark. But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.” That is the Marcus of Colossians 4:10, Barnabas’ sister’s son.

“And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus; And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God. And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.”

It shows you not just anybody can travel. Paul gave him a chance, and when it came to the work he was nowhere to be found; he came up missing. Paul said straight, I do not care if that is your nephew, he is not traveling with me any more. Barnabas said, that is my sister’s son, I am taking him with me. You can understand that dynamic. The faithful ministers like Epaphras are the ones who stay with the work.

thread.label: Colossians 1:26-27
thread.text: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:

classes.title: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.label: Matthew 4:15
precepts.why:
Colossians speaks of “the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints,” once again using that term saints, and then of “the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles.” There is a Christian out there watching who will say, see, Gentiles means the other nations. Matthew shows who the Gentiles are.

“The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles.” Zebulun and Naphtali are Israelite tribes of the northern kingdom, and their land is called Galilee of the Gentiles.

So the mystery among the Gentiles is that the northern kingdom can come back into the fold: “which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.” We had no hope unless Christ came and died for us. There was no repentance and no reconciliation, except through Christ.

precepts.label: Ephesians 3:3-6
precepts.why:
Ephesians, Colossians and Philemon were written in the same period, around AD 60 to 67 while Paul was under house arrest in Rome, to the same region. That is why they overlap and speak of the same things, like this mystery.

“How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words, Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ) Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit; That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel.”

That is the mystery: the animal sacrifice is done away with, no longer in play, and the northern and southern kingdom now have a chance to come back into the fold with Christ. Partakers of his promise, the covenant: the promises were not made through animal sacrifice but through Christ. That is the same “mystery among the Gentiles” of Colossians 1:27, Christ in you, the hope of glory.

thread.label: Colossians 3:1
thread.text: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

classes.title: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.label: Galatians 3:16-22
precepts.why:
“If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above.” If you decide to repent and follow Christ, this is what you do. If you do not want to accept Christ, it is not for you; all Israel is not Israel, as Romans 9:6 says. Galatians shows who it is for.

“Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made.” Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, and from that came the twelve tribes of Israel. “He saith not, And to seeds, as of many”: not to every nation, just that chosen lineage. “But as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.” Through that lineage came Jesus the Christ.

“Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made.” The promise was made to the twelve tribes of Israel. As soon as Christ came on the scene, animal sacrifice was done away with. “Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.”

“Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid.” If a law could have given life, righteousness would have been by the law. “But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.” That is not talking about everybody. From verse 16 it is the Israelites that believe on Christ who get the promises. There should be no confusion: those are the ones risen with Christ.

precepts.label: Romans 3:29-30
precepts.why:
Galatians says “a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.” Romans explains it: “Is he the God of the Jews only?” Is he only for the southern kingdom? “Is he not also of the Gentiles?” Is he not also the God of the northern kingdom? “Yes, of the Gentiles also.”

“Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.” The circumcision is Judah, the southern kingdom; the uncircumcision is the northern kingdom. One God justifies both, by faith.

That is who Colossians 3:1 is speaking to: “If ye then be risen with Christ.” Both houses of Israel, Jew and Gentile, who believe on Christ are risen with him, and the promise by faith of Jesus Christ is given to them that believe.

thread.label: Colossians 3:10-11
thread.text: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

classes.title: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.label: James 1:1
precepts.why:
“Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free.” A Christian will say, to hell with all the facts you just showed, because Greeks, Barbarians and Scythians are the other nations. Really, after reading all of that in context? No.

A history of the Jewish diaspora shows that the Jews in the western diaspora basically knew only Greek; their Torah reading and prayer were conducted in Greek, and the scripture was translated into Greek for those communities. So some of our people were called Greeks and some were called Jews, a language difference, but the same people. Barbarian comes from the Greek barbaros, what the early Greeks called all foreigners, including the Romans.

James writes “to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.” Would it be a surprise for us to be called Greeks and barbarians? We were scattered abroad throughout the four corners of the earth, and Esau with his demonic self has tried to insert himself in our place.

Israel Redivivus by Frederick Charles Danvers says each tribe was divided into families and subtribes, and later many tribes bearing different names were known collectively to the Greeks as Scythians, the nomadic people of that area. We were scattered everywhere, so we are the Barbarians, we are the Scythians, we are the Greeks. Get mad; this is our book.

precepts.label: Acts 2:10
precepts.why:
Barbarian was the word the Greeks used for all foreigners, including the Romans. And we were the Romans too; that is what mainstream Christianity does not understand today. Acts 2 lists the people gathered at Pentecost: “Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes.”

Strangers of Rome. And verse 5 already said who they all were: “And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.” Jews, devout men, out of every nation.

So we were called Romans, we were called Greeks, we were called barbarians. When Colossians 3:11 says “neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian,” those are the names Israel carried in the places it was scattered, not the other nations.

precepts.label: Acts 10:34-36
precepts.why:
Colossians 3:11 ends, “but Christ is all, and in all.” Now they will say, see, Christ is in all. Then they go to Acts 10: “Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.”

Read the whole thing: “The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)” Lord of all what? Lord of all Israel, scattered in every nation.

And Paul clears it up himself in the very next verse of Colossians: “Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved.” Isaiah 45:4 says “Israel mine elect”; Leviticus 20:26 says the Lord has “severed you from other people”; Baruch calls Israel “his beloved.” He is speaking in a language we can understand, not for the heathen. They know good and well this Bible does not belong to them, but in slavery they played on our ignorance. Now the God of Israel has poured His spirit on His people in these last days, and we know what the Bible is talking about.

thread.label: Colossians 3:12-13
thread.text: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

classes.title: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.label: Isaiah 45:4
precepts.why:
In verse 11 Paul references us as the Greeks, the Barbarians and the Scythians. Then in verse 12 he says it one more time, plainly: “Put on therefore, as the elect of God”. He is speaking in a language we can understand, not for the heathens to understand. Isaiah tells us who the elect of God is: “For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect”.

Israel is his elect. So the elect of God that Paul is instructing in Colossians 3:12 are Israelites.

They know good and well this Bible don’t belong to them. But in slavery they played on our ignorance. We couldn’t read or write; they taught it to us by oral tradition, wouldn’t let us read the Bible, and gave us the slave Bible where the majority of the Bible wasn’t even there. They wanted to keep us docile, ignorant and misinformed. But there is a God, the God of Israel, who has poured his spirit upon his people in these last days, and now we know what the Bible is talking about: Israel mine elect.

precepts.label: Leviticus 20:26
precepts.why:
Colossians 3:12 calls the elect of God “holy and beloved”. Leviticus tells us how to be holy, and who it is for: “And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the Lord am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.”

Holy means severed, separated from all other nations on the face of the earth. He has severed us from other people, “that ye should be mine”: that ye, you Israelites, should be his people.

So right there in Colossians 3:12 the Lord is saying it ain’t all nations. Just in case anyone was confused by what Paul was saying in verse 11, he clears it up in verse 12. The ones told to put on mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness and longsuffering are the holy people, the ones severed from the other nations to be his.

precepts.label: Baruch 3:36
precepts.why:
Holy, and beloved. Baruch shows who the beloved is: “He hath found out all the way of knowledge, and hath given it unto Jacob his servant, and to Israel his beloved.” Israel is his beloved, and it is to Israel he gave all the way of knowledge.

So the “holy and beloved” of Colossians 3:12 are the children of Israel: holy because he severed them from other people, beloved because he calls Israel his beloved.

That is why the Lord, through the apostle Paul, instructs the Colossians on how to deal with one another: “bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering; Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another”. Why? Because we are the same people. We are the sons and daughters of the living God, and there is a way we have to govern ourselves and treat each other.

thread.label: Colossians 3:22
thread.text: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:

classes.title: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.label: Ezekiel 25:8
precepts.why:
“Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh”. Going precept upon precept and in context, these servants would have to be Israelites, and these masters would have to be Israelites. It is a scripture they cherry-picked to fit their evil narrative. In The Religious Instruction of the Negroes in the United States they wrote of us, the 697,697 slaves of the 1790 census, as the original stock, in a state of absolute heathenism. They inserted themselves as the people and made us the heathens.

But the Lord did say this would happen: “Thus saith the Lord God; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen”. Moab and Seir look at the house of Judah and call us heathen.

How did we become like the heathen? By following after the heathen: celebrating their pagan rituals, Christmas, Thanksgiving; eating crab, shrimp, pork, lobster; praying to a white man. That is what makes us heathenistic. So the servants of Colossians 3:22 are Israel, and the enemy calling Judah heathen is only what the Lord already said Moab and Seir would say.

precepts.label: Galatians 3:7-8
precepts.why:
Our enemies would like to think God cast us away because we became like the heathen, and that he isn't going to redeem us. Even with us becoming heathens, this is what the Lord says: “Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham. And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.”

The scripture foreseeing: the Lord already knew we were going to become heathens. He saw that this would happen to us, and he would justify us through faith, through Christ. They may be mad all over again; it doesn't matter. We are still God's chosen people.

So the heathen Galatians speaks of justifying is Israel fallen into heathenism, the same servants Colossians 3:22 speaks to. That justification is only for one people, as Isaiah 45:25 shows.

precepts.label: Isaiah 45:25
precepts.why:
Galatians says God would “justify the heathen through faith”. Who is that justification for? “In the Lord shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.” Shall the seed of what be justified? Israel.

So it is what it is. Yes, we became heathen, following after the heathen in their holidays, their foods and their white image; but we are still going to be justified through Christ, and we shall glory. The justification is for one people, the seed of Israel.

That is why the servants of Colossians 3:22 are Israelites and not the slave master's property to be taught his religion. The masters' books called us heathens in need of their instruction, but the Lord had already written that all the seed of Israel, heathen as we became, would be justified in him.

precepts.label: Acts 5:31
precepts.why:
In 1673 Mr. Baxter published his Christian Directory with directions to masters in foreign plantations who have negroes and other slaves, a rubric to follow. In their evil minds they really believed they were masters. Did the Lord allow this to happen? Absolutely. But that is not what Colossians 3:22 is talking about. The first direction: remember that they have immortal souls and are equally capable of salvation with yourselves. That is where the false sense of equality comes from. It comes from slavery; it comes from Christianity.

Who is salvation for? “Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.” A savior brings salvation, and that salvation is only for the children of Israel.

They believed they could be saved and then us; they are the people, and we come after. That is not how it goes. The same directions said that they and you are equally under the government and laws of God, and that is incorrect: we are not equal with these people. Christ was exalted to give repentance to Israel, so the servants of Colossians and the salvation preached to them belong to Israel.

precepts.label: Daniel 9:24
precepts.why:
The slave masters' directions said that God is their reconciled tender father. God is our reconciled father, but that reconciliation is not for everybody. What does re mean? To do again: repeat, redo. Reconcile means to do it again. So if they wrote that reconciliation was for the slaves, that means they knew who we are.

Reconciliation cannot apply to the other nations, because they were never a people close or near to God. The Israelites are the only ones that have been close or near to God. Daniel shows it: “Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.”

That is determined upon Daniel's people and holy city, and the most Holy anointed is Christ. Through Christ we get our reconciliation. So the very masters who twisted Colossians 3:22 wrote down, in their own directions, that their slaves were the people God reconciles: Israel.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:48
precepts.why:
The third direction to the masters: serve your necessities by your slaves so as to prefer God's interest and their spiritual and everlasting happiness; teach them the way to heaven. So in want of all things we wanted food, clothing, housing, shelter, and we also got that old time religion from them too.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”. In want of all things: even our religion had to come from the enemy we were serving.

The next page shows what that religion was for. They wrote that we were redeemed with them by Christ from the slavery of Satan and may live with them in the liberty of the saints in glory. They want us to go to heaven with them and live with them. That's called hell. That mind was beaten into us: a brother on the street asked if the Edomite could be saved, and said if he goes to hell, so will I, because he doesn't want to go anywhere without his master. That is the want of all things the curse brought, and why the master's reading of Colossians 3:22 still holds our people.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 5:19
precepts.why:
The masters' own book says of us: they are in the eye of the law property. In the eyes of their laws, we were their property. The Lord told us why: “And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doeth the Lord our God all these things unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours.”

We are serving strangers in a land that is not ours, a land we are not familiar with. That is the servitude the Lord allowed because we forsook him.

So the slavery here was the curse on Israel for serving strange gods, not the obedience Colossians 3:22 teaches between Israelite servants and Israelite masters. They took the scripture and used it to hold us as property, but the Lord had already told us we would serve strangers.

precepts.label: Lamentations 5:8
precepts.why:
Jeremiah said we would serve strangers in a land that is not ours. The Lamentations goes further: “Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.” Servants have ruled over us. This is Bible prophecy.

It happened in the time of Assyria, Babylon, Persia, Greece, Rome, and America in the present day. It keeps happening over and over again. Why? Because we are the people of God. But this is the last time.

So the masters who took Colossians 3:22 and told us “Servants, obey in all things your masters” were themselves the servants ruling over Israel, just as the prophets lamented, with none to deliver us out of their hand.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 5:42
precepts.why:
Servants ruling over us happened with Assyria, Babylon, Persia, Greece, Rome, and America present day. The Lord explains it to Ezra: “And he said unto me, I will liken my judgment unto a ring”.

A ring is a circular motion. You see this curse? It comes right back around, empire after empire, and it keeps happening because we are the people of God. But this is the last time. All praise to the Most High.

So the slavery in America where Colossians 3:22 was used against us is one more turn of that ring of judgment on Israel. It was not the Lord making the white man our rightful master; it was his judgment coming back around on his own people, and it ends with this last time.

precepts.label: Nehemiah 9:37
precepts.why:
We were their property, and they still view us as that. They may have said we were equal in salvation, but while we were here they treated us like beasts: chattel slavery, three-fifths of a man. They never looked at us as their equals.

Nehemiah prayed it: “And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins”. This is happening because we sinned against our God. “also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.” Dominion over our bodies, to look at us as their property, at their pleasure.

Their own book says it plainly: they are in the eye of the law property over which there is an absolute control; and by law or custom we were excluded from education, and by consequence from the reading of the word of God. If we were equal, why were we excluded from education? Because they don't want us to know the truth of the Bible, that servants obey your masters isn't talking about them. They want to keep us docile and uneducated.

precepts.label: Revelation 13:14-15
precepts.why:
Their book says we may, according to the power lodged in our hands, forbid religious meetings, and no independent churches were allowed, so we depended on them alone. It went on during the Inquisition too, when they changed Christianity into the all-inclusive Catholic system and went around killing us, the real Jews, tearing up our safe houses and taking our book. The same thing is going to happen again, because now we know the truth. The only way the lie could hold strong was to destroy anybody who did not get down with it.

Revelation shows it: he “deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast”. “And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast”: that is the false image of Christ. “that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.”

If we did not agree to it, we were killed. Over time our people knew it wasn't true, but they didn't want to be killed, so they went with the lie, generation after generation. But it's a new generation on the earth, and we aren't accepting the lies any more. We know we are the people, and we know what comes with the territory.

precepts.label: Isaiah 32:7
precepts.why:
The masters' book called us the most needy of any people in their country. It does say needy, and the Bible says it too: “The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.”

The needy in that book is us. The churl devised wicked devices with lying words: cherry-picking “Servants, obey in all things your masters”, writing directions for masters to bring slaves to their religion, forbidding our meetings and our reading.

And even when we speak straight out of the Bible, going precept upon precept, they call it hate speech. That is the needy speaking right and the churl answering with lying words to destroy the poor. So when Colossians 3:22 is read in context, it speaks of Israelite servants and Israelite masters, and the lying words that turned it against us are the churl's devices.

thread.label: Colossians 4:1
thread.text: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

classes.title: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 19:21
precepts.why:
Colossians 3:22, read in context, says “Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God”. Why? Your master was taking care of your clothes, your raiment, your housing, your food. So why would you disrespect him? Number one, that is your brother. Number two, he is doing this for you: as you do your duties and work, he takes care of you.

Sirach says it: “If a servant say to his master, I will not do as it pleaseth thee; though afterward he do it, he angereth him that nourisheth him.” The master nourishes the servant, and a servant who refuses him angers the one that feeds him.

And you are not just angering the master. You are also angering the Lord that nourisheth us. That is the order Colossians 4:1 completes from the other side: the servant honours the master, and the master gives the servant “that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.”

precepts.label: Ephesians 6:5-6
precepts.why:
“Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal”. They said that they were the masters. Did they do that? No. They were living in the big house; we were living in the outhouse, and when we got emancipated, did they ever give us the forty acres and the mule? No. So they are showing that they are hypocrites. They are impostors. They’re the damn devil that the Bible speaks of.

Remember, Colossians, Ephesians and Philemon were all written generally at the same time, to the same region. Ephesians says the same thing Colossians does: “Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ; Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart”.

The servants are serving “as unto Christ”, as “the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart.” This is instruction to one people serving under Christ, not a charter for the slave masters of America, and the verse ends by reminding the masters they “also have a Master in heaven.”

precepts.label: Jeremiah 34:9
precepts.why:
To go a little deeper into who these servants are, Jeremiah says: “That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit, of a Jew his brother.”

Being a what? An Hebrew, or an Hebrewess. So these servants are Israelites. And the one they served was “a Jew his brother.”

That is the servant and master of Colossians 3:22 and 4:1: Israelite servants and Israelite masters, brothers. Christianity took a scripture about brethren and cherry-picked it to fit its evil narrative over us.

precepts.label: 1 Timothy 6:1-2
precepts.why:
Paul elaborates on the masters: “Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.” The servants are under the yoke, the yoke of bondage. If you had a master who still believed in the law of sacrifice, but you believed on Christ, you still honoured him. He follows sacrifice, but you still treat him with respect.

“And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren”. Now you have Israelite masters who believe on Christ. Don’t despise a master, your brother, that believes on Christ, because they are brethren.

Not one time has the Lord ever said we are brothers with the other nations. So that is showing you those masters are Israelites. When Colossians 4:1 tells masters to give their servants what is just and equal, it is speaking to Israelite masters over Israelite servants, their brethren.

precepts.label: Galatians 3:28
precepts.why:
Now this makes more sense: “There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.”

Neither Jew nor Greek we already understand from Colossians 3:11: the Greek-speaking Jews and the Jews. Neither bond nor free: the Israelite servant and the Israelite master. Neither male nor female: the manservant and the maidservant, the Israelite man and the Israelite woman.

“for ye are all one”: we are all one nation, under Christ. That is all it is talking about. So the servants and masters of Colossians 4:1 are one people in Christ, and that is why the master must give the servant what is just and equal.

precepts.label: Leviticus 25:55
precepts.why:
More on these servants: “For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.”

The children of Israel are servants, and they are his servants, the ones he brought out of Egypt. That is who the servants of Colossians are, and why the masters must remember they “also have a Master in heaven”: the servants belong to the Lord.

They changed the narrative and flipped the script, inserting themselves into the scriptures where they are not. Where they are, Leviticus shows it right after: “Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you”, and “they shall be your bondmen for ever”. They were originally our possession, but we sinned against our God and became their possession. Don’t worry: it is going to go back to the way it is supposed to be.

precepts.label: Romans 14:4
precepts.why:
When we read precept upon precept, in the context of the scriptures, we see how we have been lied to as a people. Paul asks: “Who art thou that judgest another man’s servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth.”

Who are you to judge another man’s servant? To his own master he stands or falls. So our real master is Christ. That is the “Master in heaven” of Colossians 4:1, the one both servants and masters answer to.

And the servant is not left alone: “Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.” There it is. For God is able to make him stand.

thread.text: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

precepts.label: Isaiah 35:4
precepts.why:
Paul thanks God “because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth.” That is what the body needs: brothers and sisters charitable toward each other, with that charity abounding, “in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure.” We will suffer for the kingdom of God, and in the suffering we still have to maintain love for our neighbor. It is not about one man; it is about the body of Christ.

Then: “Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you.” The ones troubling the apostles in Thessalonica were Rome. And the Lord Jesus shall be revealed “in flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ.” Christ is coming back for vengeance. That was never taught in church, but it has been in the Bible all along.

Isaiah says the same thing in the Old: “Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.” Be strong and do not fear; your God is coming back with vengeance and with the recompense we just read in Thessalonians.

“He will come and save you”: not all people. He is coming to save the Israelites. He is not coming for Christians, not for the Baptists, not for any denomination. And the vengeance falls on those who obey not the gospel, like our people who keep repeating the same evil every year, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year’s, knowing these things are not of God.

thread.text: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;

classes.title: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

precepts.label: John 8:32

“For that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition.” The falling away was us going into captivity and being cut off from our heritage. The last thing that has to happen is the revealing of the man of sin. That is why they do not want the true history of America taught: when it is taught, people look at him and say, that is the devil incarnate. When Ghana brought a resolution to the UN naming slavery the worst genocide ever, America would not even vote for it, because he will not admit his cruelty. The man of sin is a liar from birth. The Tuskegee study promised free health care to black men in Alabama and watched them go blind and die of syphilis for forty years, withholding penicillin even after it was discovered. And the biggest lie of all: you are a Gentile. No, we are Israelites.

That is where John 8:32 comes in: “And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.” We do not follow his lies anymore. No Christmas, no 4th of July, no Valentine’s Day, no birthdays, nothing he prescribes. We follow the Bible, because the only truth there is, is in the Bible. If you do not follow this Bible, you are a slave.

No empire will sit back while you expose it. This is war against the most sadistic men ever to walk the earth: men who threw babies in the air in Haiti to cut them in half for sport, buried men to the neck under molasses for the ants, and fed pregnant women to dogs; and Epstein Island shows he has not changed. Christ said the next time he meets that man he will not meet him as a man. Our weapon against him is this book and this truth, and we cannot be lollygagging and playing with it.

precepts.label: Luke 21:24
precepts.why:
“For that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first.” The day is the day of Christ, when he comes back in flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God. But first there has to be a falling away. What is that? Christ tells us.

“And they shall fall by the edge of the sword.” The Israelites fell by the sword of the Romans; we fell in 70 AD. “And shall be led away captive into all nations”: we fell away into captivity and were dispersed into all nations. That is the falling away. Deuteronomy 28 has to be fulfilled: the day of Christ will not come until Israel first goes into captivity for the evil they did.

“And Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles.” So Netanyahu is a Gentile. That is what Christ said. The Jewish people there, the fake Jews, are Gentiles, thus saith the Lord. The ones starving out the Palestinians, bombing them and causing all kinds of ruckus in Iran are not the children of God.

Then “that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition.” Esau, the man of sin, has to be revealed to the whole planet, until everybody knows and agrees that this is the son of perdition, the devil on earth. America, with its long list of countries bombed and leaders overthrown, is the most powerful villain: Mystery Babylon the Great.

thread.label: 1 Timothy 4:1
thread.text: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;

precepts.label: Psalms 119:142
precepts.why:
“Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils.” This is a prophecy about the world's last religion, the one they will force on us, and some of you, men and women, will give yourselves to it. We are living in the latter times.

What are the doctrines of devils? “Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron; Forbidding to marry.” Here is the clue: what religion forbids men to marry? Catholicism, Christianity; they forbid their priests to marry. Then “commanding to abstain from meats”: Lent, forty days with no meat. Meats “which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.”

What is the truth? David answers: “Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.” The truth is God's laws. Those who know the law receive what God created with thanksgiving; those seduced by doctrines of devils forbid to marry and abstain from meats.

Why do people get seduced into all this crap? Because they were idle, I-D-L-E, and they were given Christianity, an idol, I-D-O-L. Christianity is an idolatrous religion. The one who holds the law, the truth, will not depart from the faith.

precepts.label: Matthew 24:10
precepts.why:
In the latter times “some shall depart from the faith.” Christ said the same in Matthew 24: “And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.”

Many of you shall be offended. What are you going to do? You are going to betray the believing brothers and sisters, and you shall hate us. That is the departing from the faith Paul prophesied.

Read on: “And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.” That is this Christianity. On TikTok everybody is a pastor: every man, every woman, every boy, every girl, out of nowhere. Those who depart from the faith are the ones who give heed to them, and they end up offended at the truth and betraying and hating the people who taught it to them.

precepts.label: Mark 13:22
precepts.why:
Paul says those who depart from the faith give “heed to seducing spirits.” Mark shows where that seducing spirit comes from: “For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.”

The false Christs and false prophets rise on TikTok and Instagram. These Christians under Israel's banner, the fake Israel's banner, get millions of dollars, and America works her science for Israel. Remember in Revelation how they called fire down from heaven, and that fire from heaven was called wonders on the earth. Those are the signs and wonders.

They rise “to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.” That lets us know there will be a seducing spirit in the last days to get us back into Christianity, back into colonialism, back into that damnable slave religion called Christianity. The seducing spirit that Mark, Matthew and Paul to Timothy all address is in these days.

Revelation names the three unclean spirits like frogs: out of the mouth of the dragon, politics; out of the mouth of the beast, the United States and its financial system; “and out of the mouth of the false prophet”, religion, which is Christianity. “For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles”, gathering the kings of the earth to the battle of that great day. So do not tell us the Bible is not true. If you want to play games and go back into Christianity, go; there are no bars on the door.

thread.label: 2 Timothy 1:7
thread.text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

precepts.label: Psalms 42:5
precepts.why:
“For God hath not given us the spirit of fear”. When fear or trouble tries to put you down, David shows how to talk to your own soul: “Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.”

David is speaking to himself, to his soul. Put plain: I might be down, but I'm not broken. I might be down, but I'm not out yet. Satan tried to take me out, but I'm still fighting. My hope is in the Lord, and I still have some fight in me.

Some of you are quick to give up. As soon as something happens, you run out: why did they have to put correction? Correction is a good thing. It keeps you on your toes, it makes you better and stronger. What doesn't break you makes you stronger; that is correction, that is the word of God. You can use a brother's correction to build yourself up: in my mind I was going to do what this brother got corrected for, so let me move from it. Moses said some you correct openly, so that others fear. Some of you never were corrected in your life until you came to IUIC, and you are too prideful to take it.

Brothers, never keep a yes-man around you. If you have a man in your circle who cannot say, bro, I don't think you should do this, that man hates you and is waiting for your downfall. You want men who tell you, don't talk evil of leadership; if you have a problem with a brother, go to him. Sisters are the same: the sister who won't tell you what you want to hear is not your enemy, she is the one you want around you, because she has no respect of persons. Men like that help you get the kingdom of heaven.

precepts.label: Psalms 38:8-9
precepts.why:
David was down but not out, and he did not hide it from God: “I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.” To roar is to utter or express in a loud tone: to cry, shout, yell. David says, I'm feeble, I'm broken, and I cried out because of the disquietness of my heart.

“Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.” He laid it all before the Lord.

Some of you, when you pray, do not pray for yourself, because you think you are perfect. You need to pray for yourself and ask for help to overcome certain things. Some of you are fighting lust; when you fast, pray that Messiah helps you overcome that lust. We all have lust. Our lust might be different things, but we all have it. Some of you are fighting a covetous spirit; pray that Messiah helps you overcome it.

You are not going to walk into the kingdom of heaven thinking you're perfect and your stuff don't stink. Put your desire and your groaning before the Lord, so that when the storm comes, fear does not overtake you.

precepts.label: Revelation 2:26
precepts.why:
You won't walk into the kingdom thinking you are perfect. This is what Christ said: “And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations”.

The word is overcome. Brothers, you must overcome the lust of America, and you must also overcome the personal thing you struggle with. We all struggle with things. Some of you struggle with lust, with porn, with prostitution, with drugs. Some of you are crackheads, weed heads; some of you it's cigarettes, Black and Milds, women. And yes, it is said to shame you. This is not my word; don't get mad at me. Read what Christ says you have to do.

The words “keepeth my works” mean keep my commandments, keep my laws. My works is this book: keep it. If you keep it, that means you have overcome. You must overcome, or else you are not going to make it to the kingdom.

So when you watch all these prophecies happen, don't include yourself if you won't let the lust go. Some of you need to let things go. That is how you keep from the spirit of fear: you prepare your mind in the scriptures and overcome, so that Esau has nothing to hold over you and you don't betray your brother to hide what you were watching.

precepts.label: Sirach 2:5
precepts.why:
“For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity.” You are that gold. We are that gold. How do you purify gold? By putting it in the fire. Some of you need to go into the fire. You have stuff on you that has to be purged out, but you want to keep it and still have the kingdom of heaven. If you don't want to be purged, you cannot get the kingdom. Some of you want to be iron, some of you want to be silver; you have to be that gold.

What is the purpose of going through all that and not getting the kingdom? Esau has been putting you through hell all your life, and you end up missing the kingdom because you hold on to things and don't want God to take the unclean out of you.

Some of you hold on to things that happened fifty years ago, twenty years ago, five years ago. That's like a woman in an argument: you're talking about the orange and she says, yeah, but the pineapple happened five years ago. There's no pineapple here; we're talking about the orange. Some sisters got notes, waiting to bring them out. Men should not be emotional like that.

And “acceptable men in the furnace of adversity”: it takes a strong man to take correction. Weak men cannot. When correction comes, the strong man gets up, repents and keeps moving, and you can tell he is still in the fight. When you get correction, that's when you push harder. Don't lay back. Prove to Messiah, not to leadership, that you are still in the fight.

thread.label: 2 Timothy 2:19-21
thread.text: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

precepts.label: 2 Timothy 3:1-5
precepts.why:
Paul says in a great house there are vessels “of gold and of silver” and also “of wood and of earth”, and “If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour.” The next chapter names who those vessels of dishonour are: “This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come. For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy, Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good, Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God.”

“Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof.” Why does it say a form of godliness? That is the fringes everybody wears and the border of blue, walking around with your Bible, saying Most High, in Christ, blessed heartily. But you are not keeping the laws in your heart. You are really not keeping the commandments.

The great house is the nation of Israel, the real nation of Israel. There are brothers and sisters of gold and silver, applying what we read in 1 Peter 2:1-2. And there are brothers and sisters with fringes and a border of blue who are no damn good. They have not changed their lives; they are the same as they were two, three years ago. Not the new people who just came in, but people who have been with us for years and are still grimy: still that secret adulterer, that liar, complainer, murmurer. You are that wood and that earth. In every IUIC school there are men and women of honour and of dishonour, and the captains must be able to identify which is which. If you can’t do that, there is a problem.

“from such turn away.” That is what he said in the chapter before: purge yourself from these. Purge means cut them off, cut them loose. When you purge a plant you are pruning it, taking away the bad elements. Likewise with us: the bad elements among us, you have to cut off. You know which brothers always get you in trouble. Rolling with grimy brothers, you can almost get arrested many a time; cut them off, say I’m not rolling with y’all no more, and hang out with leadership. That is how you become a vessel “sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.”

Things were not bad for Moses; Moses made things bad for himself by killing the Egyptian, and there was a consequence for killing an Egyptian, so Moses was on the run.

Exodus 5:14 shows that some of our own people were set up over us: “And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?” The taskmasters set officers of the children of Israel over us. To be an officer you were making money. Some of our people in ancient Egypt had money and high standing, a form of good living, and they were okay with the oppression they were going through, until the officers started getting their behinds whooped too.

thread.label: Hebrews 12:16-17
thread.text: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.

precepts.label: Genesis 26:34-35
precepts.why:
Hebrews calls Esau a “fornicator, or profane person”, and brothers often ask what that means. The scriptures explain it, beginning with his marriages: “Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.” His parents did not like his choice of those Hittite women.

Some unlearned Israelites use these two verses to say Esau was black, because his children were mixed with the Hittites. No. God kept that line the way it is. Even today, no matter how black you are, if you marry a white woman you can tell the child is a hybrid: high yellow, sometimes yellow hair, green eyes. Look at Drake as a boy with his family: his hair is like his father's, but his complexion is closer to his mother's.

So you mean back then God could not maintain that same look, that lighter red complexion, in Esau's line? No, God don't have that power? Shut up, Negro. Be quiet. These hybrid children look more like Esau. Mixing with the Hittites did not make Esau black; it is part of what made him a fornicator.

precepts.label: Genesis 28:8-9
precepts.why:
After the Hittite wives, Esau went further: “Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father; Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.”

Esau saw that Isaac was pissed off that he married the daughters of Canaan, and instead of turning back to his own kindred, he went to Ishmael. So now he married Arab kids too. That is what Esau was doing: taking wives outside his father's tribe, one after another.

That is the fornication Hebrews 12:16 names. Esau married the Hittites and the Ishmaelites, strange women, and he was profane because for “one morsel of meat” he sold his birthright; it meant a lot, and he did not care about it.

precepts.label: Tobit 4:12
precepts.why:
Tobit 4:12 shows why Esau is called a fornicator: “Beware of all whoredom, my son, and chiefly take a wife of the seed of thy fathers, and take not a strange woman to wife, which is not of thy father’s tribe.” Whoredom falls under fornication. Esau married Hittite women and Ishmaelite women, strange women not of his father's tribe.

Ishmael was the beginning of another race; Genesis is the beginning of races. Tobit goes on: “for we are the children of the prophets, Noe, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: remember, my son, that our fathers from the beginning, even that they all married wives of their own kindred, and were blessed in their children, and their seed shall inherit the land.”

So the fathers married within their own kindred and were blessed in their children; Esau did not. Then there is the profaneness. Hebrews says he sold his birthright “for one morsel of meat”, and that shows what was in the pottage. When Esau came in from the field faint and said, “Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage”, he wanted it as it was, raw, red and bloody. “therefore was his name called Edom”, which means red. He said, “Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?” and “thus Esau despised his birthright.” And there are brothers today lusting after these same people and having children with them.

That is why, “when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected”: rejected by God, “for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.”

It is not up to leadership to rule you men or to rule your house for you. It is not our job to tell your wife to respect you. It is your job to rule your own damn house.

A lot of you come for counsel, and counsel is given twice on the same matter. If you are counselled twice and it isn’t fixed, you aren’t listening, you are wasting our time, and something is wrong with both of you. Couples come for advice, then a couple of months later: I hate you, I hope you die; and on the Sabbath, shalom, brother, Most High and Christ bless. You are fake and phony. And brothers, we cannot make your wife respect and love you; you have to figure out how to fix that. The ones who fix it never come back: the brother says yes, I understand, goes home and fixes it, and the sister fixes it. The key is that people have to see their own faults. Some are always looking for somebody to blame, and they will blame leadership, but ruling the house is the man’s charge.

precepts.label: Ephesians 2:21-22
precepts.why:
Christ's body was the temple, and his temple today is us. Peter says “Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house”, and Paul shows how that house grows: “In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord”. All the building is you and me. See that word growing: Peter just explained how we grow, by laying aside all malice, all guile, all hypocrisies, all evil speakings, and desiring the sincere milk of the word.

You know what fitly framed together means? Stones have to come together. Brothers, we must merge together. Whatever your position is, play that position. Don't try to change positions through deceit. A brother was demoted in New York for lying over a simple thing; when we ask, most of the time we already know the answer, and when the witnesses are called, the liar is put on front street and found not worthy of his rank. A stone full of guile does not fit in the frame.

“In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.” Wherever our congregation is, that is a spiritual house, the real temple, and God dwells in it through the Spirit. That is why Zerubbabel is our example: he got to his position not only for his fighting skills but because he was of noble character, understanding God's truth. We should not be deceitful, envious, hateful or filled with guile toward one another, but lively stones with zeal, passion and fire, built together into the house where God lives.

precepts.label: 1 Corinthians 3:16-17
precepts.why:
“Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?” We are the temple, the spiritual house Peter speaks of. “If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are.” That is why we have to change the way we conduct ourselves. Our communications must change. The malice, guile, hypocrisies, envies and evil speakings of 1 Peter 2:1 defile the temple.

Paul goes on in 2 Timothy: “Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.” “But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.” The great house is the nation of Israel, the real nation. There are brothers and sisters who are gold and silver, applying 1 Peter 2:1-2. And there are those of wood and earth, meaning no good: fringes and a border of blue, but they have not changed their lives in two or three years. Not the new people, but those who have been with us for years and are still grimy, still that secret adulterer, still that liar, complainer, murmurer.

The captains must be able to identify in their school who is honourable and who is dishonourable. “If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.” Purge means cut them off, like pruning a plant and taking away the bad elements. I knew which brothers always got me in trouble; I almost got arrested many a time with those grimy brothers, and I had to cut them off and hang out with leadership. Keep the temple holy.

precepts.label: 2 Timothy 4:12
precepts.why:
John is told, “What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia”, and the first of them is Ephesus. Paul writes to Timothy, “And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.”

That same Tychicus was sent to Colosse. In Colossians 4, “All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts”, together “With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you.”

Ephesus is right there next to Colosse. The same messengers served that whole region, going between the churches of Asia. So the Colossians were not off by themselves: they were part of that same body of churches in Asia that Christ sent his word to in Revelation.

precepts.label: Colossians 4:16
precepts.why:
Paul tells the Colossians, “And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.” The letters went back and forth between Colosse and Laodicea.

Laodicea is the last of the seven churches in Revelation 1:11: “Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.” And Laodicea was right there next to Colosse.

Now it connects better. Colosse may not be named as one of the churches of Asia in the book of Acts, but when you put the map up, the churches of Asia are all right there together: Laodicea, Philadelphia, Sardis, all right there by Colosse. So when John was told to send what he saw “unto the seven churches which are in Asia”, it was the same region and the same people the epistle to the Colossians was written to.

It isn't the real Egypt, but a spiritual Egypt: that's why the Egyptian pyramid is on the back of your dollar bill, with the all-seeing eye of Horus at the top, 1776 at the bottom, and the Latin for a new secular order, the new world order.

“where also our Lord was crucified”: it isn't the real Jerusalem, but a spiritual Jerusalem, because our people hate the real biblical Christ, that black Christ, and his teachings of the law. They want a white Jesus who teaches love for everybody: if it feels good, just do it. Remember they said we have no king but Caesar.

That great city is the “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH”, “that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth”. We wandered out of the way of understanding God's laws. So we are the congregation of the dead, and our dead bodies lie in the streets of Babylon the great, America, the spiritual Sodom and Egypt.

The dead bodies of Revelation 11:8 are not a graveyard somewhere; they are our people, living in the street of the great city but dead to the laws of God.

precepts.label: Baruch 3:4
precepts.why:
Who are the dead bodies lying in the street of the great city? Baruch names them: “O Lord Almighty, thou God of Israel, hear now the prayers of the dead Israelites”. He is calling us the dead Israelites.

We are not physically dead, but spiritually we are a dead race of people: filled with hatred, filled with adulteries, filled with pornography; some child molesters, drug dealers, drug users, drug abusers. We hate each other and can't get along. That is why it calls us the dead Israelites.

So Revelation 11:8 is speaking of us: the dead Israelites whose bodies lie in the street of Babylon the great, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.

precepts.label: Revelation 17:5

Why dead? Because we don’t know who we are; we are in a dead state of mind; we left off keeping God’s laws.

Where is the great city? Revelation 17:5: “And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.” That great city is Mystery Babylon the Great: America. And America is the abomination of the earth.

That is why it is spiritually called Sodom: sodomy goes on here; they legalized it. And it is spiritually called Egypt because, the same way the Israelites were enslaved in ancient Egypt, the Israelites were enslaved and are oppressed here in America: the land of oppression, the land of bondage, the land of slavery. What our forefathers experienced in ancient Egypt, they experienced here, and wherever those ships took us. And as God brought plagues on ancient Egypt, he is bringing plagues on this new Egypt.

precepts.label: Baruch 3:10
precepts.why:
Baruch goes on: “How happeneth it Israel, that thou art in thine enemies’ land”? Now we are in our enemies’ land. America is your enemies’ land; they are the ones ruling this place.

“That thou art waxen old in a strange country”: we have waxed old in strange countries, because our land is the land of Israel.

“That thou art defiled with the dead”. What does it mean that we are defiled with the dead? We walk around like zombies. precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:48-51
precepts.why:
“And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle”. Who is the eagle? The eagle was Rome at the time, and Rome is an extension of this place called America. Moses tells us about that eagle: “The Lord shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth”. That's Rome, when they came in and attacked us in Luke 21, the abomination of desolation of Matthew 24:15, when they destroyed us and ran us out of Jerusalem. From the end of the earth: from Europe.

“a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand”: we did not understand their tongue when they landed here. Columbus found the Taino, a people who shared food, land and knowledge and fed him as an honored guest, and he wrote that they would make fine servants, and with fifty men he could make them do whatever he wanted. They knew what they came for. Within fifty years the Taino nation was virtually extinct. In Africa they sent explorers, missionaries with Bibles and the cross, and traders with gifts first; they ate at the tables of kings while mapping the gold and rubber, got treaties signed in crafty, ambiguous words, and at the Berlin conference of 1884 sat around a table and split up the continent. They came as swift as the eagle flieth. You can never trust that red man, that devil, that dragon.

“A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young”: they didn't care about old or young; they put everybody to death and enslaved everybody. “And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed”, and leave neither “corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of thy kine”, kine being cattle, “until he have destroyed thee.”

Then the woman is nourished in her place, and that is America, where we've been nourished through their welfare system, their disability system, their politics, their religions, their educational and economic system. “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”. Hungry, thirsty, needing clothing, a passport, a visa, a death certificate, anything we need, we have to go to them. “and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” The red man put a yoke of iron upon our necks, and we are destroyed today as a people. Even the ones speaking up for us say we love America: that is how destroyed we are.

precepts.label: Revelation 12:9
precepts.why:
The woman is nourished “from the face of the serpent.” Jump to verse 9 to see who the serpent is: “And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.”

That old serpent is the serpent from Genesis. He is called the Devil and Satan, and he deceived everybody; he deceived this whole world. He was cast out into the earth with his angels. That is who the face of the serpent is: the devil himself and his kids, the white man, the red man. They are the enemies Deuteronomy 28:48 says we serve, called the serpent in Revelation.

That is why verse 12 says “Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.” Woe means death and destruction; this earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He is mad right now, and that is why we are going through it.

And verse 15: “the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman”. That flood is his media, his witchcraft, the same script read word for word on every station, the deceiving of the whole world coming out of the dragon's mouth. But “the earth helped the woman”: this Bible helps us understand what happened to us, what is happening now, and what is going to happen.

precepts.label: Isaiah 24:21
precepts.why:
This proves who the heavens are in Revelation 12:12. “And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high”. The high ones that are on high are the ones ruling the earth today: America and Europe. They are the fourth beast, the red dragon, the spiritual wickedness in high places. The Lord shall punish them for all the evil they are doing, and with them the Europeans living in the land of Israel that say they are Jews.

Then: “and the kings of the earth upon the earth.” The kings of the earth are Iran, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, India, Pakistan, Ethiopia, Sudan. God is going to punish the high ones on high, and he is also going to punish those kings of the earth.

So Revelation 12:12 lines up with it. “rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them” is spoken to the high ones: rejoice now, this is your kingdom, have fun. “Woe to the inhabiters of the earth” is spoken to the kings of the earth, the nations below, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Ethiopia, India, China. The devil comes down on them with great wrath, and in that day the Lord punishes both.

precepts.label: Isaiah 34:5
precepts.why:
A second witness that the heavens are Europe and America. “For my sword shall be bathed in heaven”. That is the Lord, Christ, and it does not mean his sword is up in the sky; the verse goes on to explain who the heaven is: “behold, it shall come down upon Idumea”.

Idumea is Edom, and Edom today is Europe and America and those Europeans in the land of Israel that call themselves Jews. The sword is bathed in heaven, that is the high ones, and it comes down upon Idumea, so the heaven is the Europeans.

“and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.” God has cursed the white man; he has cursed the Europeans. That is why they have no pigment in their skin. And the sword comes down upon them to judgment: God is going to judge the high ones that are on high.

So when Revelation 12:12 says “Therefore rejoice, ye heavens”, the heavens are Edom. Rejoice now, this is your kingdom, have fun, because the sword that is bathed in heaven is coming down on you to judgment.

precepts.label: Job 20:24-27
precepts.why:
This explains the woe to the inhabiters of the earth. “He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.” He is America. The iron weapon is the missile, ballistic missiles, nuclear missiles, and the bow of steel is nuclear weapons. “It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall”: it is called a glittering sword because that is what the missiles look like when they are shooting.

“The heaven shall reveal his iniquity”. That is what you are seeing right now: the Lord is revealing the wickedness America is doing on the earth. “and the earth shall rise up against him.” The high ones on high will be oppressing the nations on the earth; they will oppress Iran, they will oppress Saudi Arabia, they will oppress all nations, and even Europe is going to get it too. And as they do that, all the kings of the earth are going to rise up against America and Israel because of that oppression.

What you see now is the beginning, and it is going to get worse. Many are hailing Iran for shooting missiles, but America could drop one of its crazy bombs, not even the nuclear one, and Iran would be done. Yet Iran will not be fully taken out, and there will be no regime change. The people of Iran will hate America even more; there will be a truce, not peace, after America bombs their nuclear sites, and according to prophecy they will rebuild it all. The powers that be think they are buying time, but the Lord is behind all of it.

That is the great wrath of Revelation 12:12. The devil comes down on the inhabiters of the earth because he knows his time is short. Every move he makes is to buy time and prolong his rule, because in his mind his house will go on forever: make sure the Arabs never come together, make sure Iran never gets nuclear capability, and bomb them. And once he finishes with the nations he is coming for us, the leaders in IUIC, to stop us from prophesying and testifying, because when we testify against him, judgment comes. They are already putting the laws in place.

precepts.label: Job 10:14

“And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads”. What is that mark? Is it a computer chip? precepts.why:
Sin is the mark when it becomes law to sin, and Maccabees shows it happening historically: “Moreover king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people, And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king.”

“Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion, and sacrificed unto idols, and profaned the sabbath.” That is Christianity: consenting to the king's religion, and profaning the sabbath.
